# Job Adapter (https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/extend/schedules/schedule-job-adapter)

The <DocsLink pkg='base' name='ScheduleJobAdapter' decorated={false} /> wraps a specific scheduled job implementation so the schedule system can interact with jobs (pause, resume, destroy) without knowing the underlying library.

There are two default implementations: <DocsLink pkg='base' name='CronJobAdapter' decorated={false} /> wraps jobs created by the `croner` library for cron strings and `Date`s, and <DocsLink pkg='base' name='TimerJobAdapter' decorated={false} /> runs millisecond intervals with its own timer.

## When to override [#when-to-override]

| ✅ Override if you want to... | ❌ Don't override if you want to... |
|---|---|
| Use a different timing/job backend (not `croner`) through a custom [`ScheduleExecutionScheduler`](/extend/schedules/schedule-execution-scheduler). | Change only schedule storage or execution behavior. Those are responsibilities of `ScheduleRepository` and `ScheduleExecutor`. |
| Adapt a third-party scheduler/queue API to Nyx's `pause`/`resume`/`destroy` contract. | Only change interval parsing or next-run calculation. That belongs to `ScheduleExecutionScheduler`. |
| Wrap platform-specific timer handles (e.g., `setTimeout`-based jobs) behind a uniform adapter API. | Add pre-execution checks. That belongs to `ScheduleMiddlewareList`. |

## Overriding [#overriding]

<Steps>
<Step>
### Creation [#creation]

Create a custom adapter implementing `ScheduleJobAdapter`.

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { ScheduleJobAdapter, ScheduleInterval } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

class SimpleTimerAdapter implements ScheduleJobAdapter<NodeJS.Timeout> {
  constructor(
    private readonly timer: NodeJS.Timeout,
    private readonly interval: ScheduleInterval
  ) {}

  public pause() {
    clearTimeout(this.timer);
    return this;
  }

  public resume() {
    this.timer.refresh();
    return this;
  }

  public destroy() {
    clearTimeout(this.timer);
    return this;
  }

  public isRunning() {
    // NodeJS.Timeout has no built-in running-state check; illustrative only.
    return true;
  }

  public getRaw() {
    return this.timer;
  }

  public getInterval() {
    return this.interval;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash

```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>

### Registration [#registration]

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { ScheduleInterval, ScheduleJobAdapter } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { DefaultScheduleExecutionScheduler } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

class MyScheduleJobAdapter implements ScheduleJobAdapter<NodeJS.Timeout> {
  constructor(
    private readonly timer: NodeJS.Timeout,
    private readonly interval: ScheduleInterval
  ) {}

  public pause() {
    clearTimeout(this.timer);
    return this;
  }

  public resume() {
    this.timer.refresh();
    return this;
  }

  public destroy() {
    clearTimeout(this.timer);
    return this;
  }

  public isRunning() {
    return true;
  }

  public getRaw() {
    return this.timer;
  }

  public getInterval() {
    return this.interval;
  }
}

class MyScheduler extends DefaultScheduleExecutionScheduler {
  // Instantiate your documented adapter in your custom scheduler flow.
  // @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
  private readonly adapter = new MyScheduleJobAdapter(/** ... */);
}
// ---cut---
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
declare const bot: NyxBot;

// @noErrors
bot.getScheduleManager().setScheduler(MyScheduler.create());
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>

# Manager (https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/extend/schedules/schedule-manager)

The `ScheduleManager` is the object that holds together the nyx schedule system. At a glance:

- Registration flow: when adding a schedule, stores it in the repository and then starts its runtime job in the scheduler.
- Failure safety: if schedule registration fails midway, rolls back repository state and scheduler job creation to stay consistent.
- Execution boundary: `tick` resolves a schedule by ID and executes it through the executor with populated metadata.
- Schedule events: emits manager-level `ScheduleAdd`/`ScheduleRemove` events and supports subscriptions for schedule lifecycle reactions.

In practice, this makes it the boundary where schedule persistence, job lifecycle, execution, and manager events are coordinated.

## Overriding [#overriding]

<Steps>
<Step>
### Creation [#creation]
Create a custom schedule manager by either:

* Extending <DocsLink pkg='base' name='DefaultScheduleManager' decorated={false} /> (<BaseMention />'s implementation, recommended for less work).
* Implementing <DocsLink pkg='base' name='ScheduleManager' decorated={false} /> (<BaseMention />'s interface).

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { DefaultScheduleManager } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

class MyScheduleManager extends DefaultScheduleManager {
  public myCustomPublicMethod() {
    return 'I work!' as const;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { DefaultScheduleManager } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

class MyScheduleManager extends DefaultScheduleManager {
  public myCustomPublicMethod() {
    return 'I work!' as const;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { DefaultScheduleManager } from '@nyx-discord/http';

class MyScheduleManager extends DefaultScheduleManager {
  public myCustomPublicMethod() {
    return 'I work!' as const;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

</Step>
<Step>
### Registration [#registration]

Then you can pass it to your bot:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { Client } from 'discord.js';
import { DefaultScheduleManager } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

class MyScheduleManager extends DefaultScheduleManager {
  public myCustomPublicMethod() {
    return 'I work!' as const;
  }
}
// ---cut---
import { Bot, type NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

const myBot = Bot.create((bot: NyxBot) => ({
  // ---cut-start---
  token: 'TOKEN',
  client: new Client({ intents: [] }),
  logger: console,
  deployCommands: true,
  // @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
  // ---cut-end---
  // ... other options
  scheduleManager: new MyScheduleManager(/** ... */),
}));

const manager = myBot.getScheduleManager();
const result = manager.myCustomPublicMethod();
//     ^?
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { Client, GatewayIntentBits } from '@discordjs/core';
import { REST } from '@discordjs/rest';
import { WebSocketManager } from '@discordjs/ws';
import { DefaultScheduleManager } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

const rest = new REST({ version: '10' }).setToken('TOKEN');
const gateway = new WebSocketManager({ token: 'TOKEN', intents: GatewayIntentBits.Guilds, rest });
const client = new Client({ rest, gateway });

class MyScheduleManager extends DefaultScheduleManager {
  public myCustomPublicMethod() {
    return 'I work!' as const;
  }
}
// ---cut---
import { Bot, CoreNyxClient, type NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

const myBot = Bot.create((bot: NyxBot) => ({
  // ---cut-start---
  token: 'TOKEN',
  client: new CoreNyxClient(client, gateway, 'APPLICATION_ID'),
  logger: console,
  deployCommands: true,
  // @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
  // ---cut-end---
  // ... other options
  scheduleManager: new MyScheduleManager(/** ... */),
}));

const manager = myBot.getScheduleManager();
const result = manager.myCustomPublicMethod();
//     ^?
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash

  public myCustomPublicMethod() {
    return 'I work!' as const;
  }
}
// ---cut---

const myBot = HttpBot.create((bot: NyxBot) => ({
  // ---cut-start---
  applicationId: 'APPLICATION_ID',
  publicKey: 'PUBLIC_KEY',
  token: 'TOKEN',

}));

const result = manager.myCustomPublicMethod();
//     ^?
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

The class is able to infer the type of your custom manager, so accessing any custom method or property will work without errors.

If you ever want to use this custom bot type with your injected manager somewhere else, you can do so via the generic:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { Client } from 'discord.js';
import { DefaultScheduleManager } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
class MyScheduleManager extends DefaultScheduleManager {
  public myCustomPublicMethod() {
    return 'I work!' as const;
  }
}
// ---cut---
import type { NyxBot, InjectableBotDependencies } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

type BotWithCustomManager = NyxBot<InjectableBotDependencies & { scheduleManager: MyScheduleManager }>;

function functionOnlyForCustomManager(bot: BotWithCustomManager) {
  const manager = bot.getScheduleManager();
  const result = manager.myCustomPublicMethod();
  //     ^?
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { Client } from 'discord.js';
import { DefaultScheduleManager } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
class MyScheduleManager extends DefaultScheduleManager {
  public myCustomPublicMethod() {
    return 'I work!' as const;
  }
}
// ---cut---

type BotWithCustomManager = NyxBot<InjectableBotDependencies & { scheduleManager: MyScheduleManager }>;

function functionOnlyForCustomManager(bot: BotWithCustomManager) {
  const manager = bot.getScheduleManager();
  const result = manager.myCustomPublicMethod();
  //     ^?
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:


  </Tab>

For readability purposes, we recommend storing the type with the generic in a separate type, like in the example.

</Step>
</Steps>


# Repository (https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/extend/schedules/schedule-repository)

The <DocsLink pkg='base' name='ScheduleRepository' decorated={false} /> is responsible for storing all the currently registered schedules.

## When to override [#when-to-override]

| ✅ Override if you want to... | ❌ Don't override if you want to... |
|---|---|
| Change schedule persistence (e.g., database instead of in-memory). | Adjust schedule execution or job lifecycle. Use `ScheduleExecutor` or `ScheduleJobAdapter` instead. |
| Enforce custom consistency/uniqueness rules at storage level (e.g., dedup by business key). | Change middleware flow or pre-execution checks. That belongs to `ScheduleMiddlewareList`. |
| Support multi-tenant partitioning or custom query/filter capabilities in storage. | Change manager event orchestration. That belongs to `ScheduleManager`. |

## Overriding [#overriding]

<Steps>
<Step>
### Creation [#creation]

Create a custom schedule repository by either:

* Extending <DocsLink pkg='base' name='DefaultScheduleRepository' decorated={false} /> (<BaseMention />'s implementation, recommended for less work).
* Implementing <DocsLink pkg='base' name='ScheduleRepository' decorated={false} /> (<BaseMention />'s interface).

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { DefaultScheduleRepository } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

class MyScheduleRepository extends DefaultScheduleRepository {
  public myCustomMethod() {
    // Custom logic
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { DefaultScheduleRepository } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

class MyScheduleRepository extends DefaultScheduleRepository {
  public myCustomMethod() {
    // Custom logic
  }

```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash

    // Custom logic
  }

```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

</Step>
<Step>
### Registration [#registration]

Create it and set it to the [`ScheduleManager`](/extend/schedules/schedule-manager).

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash

  /** Your overrides */

```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>

  </Tab>

  </Tab>

The <DocsLink pkg='base' name='DefaultScheduleRepository.create()' decorated={false} /> method instantiates your custom repository, not the default one.

</Step>

# Commands (https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/loaders/commands)

<Callout type="warn">It's recommended to read the [Commands Overview](../use/commands/) page first.</Callout>

The <DocsLink pkg="loaders" name="CommandLoader" decorated={false} /> scans a directory for command classes and returns a <DocsLink pkg="base" name="TopLevelCommand" decorated={false} />[] ready for `commandManager.addCommands()`.

## Folder structure [#folder-structure]

The loader expects a specific layout, following these rules:

1. Root-level commands are loaded as-is. They must be <DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractStandaloneCommand" decorated={false} />, <DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractParentCommand" decorated={false} />, or <DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractContextMenuCommand" decorated={false} />.
2. A <DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractParentCommand" decorated={false} /> may have a children folder with the same name as its `data.name`. The children folder must contain
<DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractSubCommand" decorated={false} /> and/or <DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractSubCommandGroup" decorated={false} /> classes, which are wired to the parent.
3. A <DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractSubCommandGroup" decorated={false} /> may have a nested children folder with the same name as its `data.name`. The nested children folder
must contain <DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractSubCommand" decorated={false} /> classes, which are wired to the group.
4. Any subdirectory that does not match a parent/group `data.name` is treated as an organizational folder and recursed into
as a new root, continuing the scan with the same rules above. This allows you to organize commands into subfolders without affecting
the command hierarchy.
5. Files with multiple classes have each class processed independently.

<Callout type="tip" title="About filenames">
The filenames are completely irrelevant for the loader. The command hierarchy is determined entirely by the `data.name` of each class and the folder structure.
</Callout>

### Example [#example]

<Files>
  <Folder name="dist/commands" defaultOpen>
    <File name="ping.js" />
    <File name="report-user.js" />
    <File name="mod.js" />
    <Folder name="mod" defaultOpen>
      <File name="ban.js" />
      <File name="mute.js" />
      <File name="settings.js" />
      <Folder name="settings" defaultOpen>
        <File name="view.js" />
        <File name="edit.js" />
      </Folder>
    </Folder>
    <Folder name="utils">
      <File name="utils.js" />
      <File name="format.js" />
    </Folder>
  </Folder>
</Files>

Assuming the exported command classes have their `data.name` set the same as their file names, the loader will produce the following command hierarchy:

| File | Type | Notes |
|------|------|-------|
| `ping.js` | <DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractStandaloneCommand" decorated={false} /> | Root-level, loaded as-is |
| `report-user.js` | <DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractContextMenuCommand" decorated={false} /> | Root-level, loaded as-is |
| `mod.js` | <DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractParentCommand" decorated={false} /> | `data.name === "mod"`, children folder matches name |
| `mod/ban.js` | <DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractSubCommand" decorated={false} /> | Inside children folder, wired to parent |
| `mod/settings.js` | <DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractSubCommandGroup" decorated={false} /> | `data.name === "settings"`, nested folder matches name |
| `mod/settings/view.js` | <DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractSubCommand" decorated={false} /> | Inside children folder, wired to group |
| `utils/utils.js` | <DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractStandaloneCommand" decorated={false} /> | Inside organizational folder, loaded as root-level |
| `utils/format.js` | <DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractStandaloneCommand" decorated={false} /> | Inside organizational folder, loaded as root-level |

## Usage [#usage]

By default, commands are automatically registered via `commandManager.addCommands()`:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot, DjsInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
declare const bot: NyxBot<any>;
// ---cut---
import { CommandLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

await CommandLoader.load<DjsInteractionTypes>({ bot, path: './dist/commands' });
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot, CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
declare const bot: NyxBot<any>;
// ---cut---
import { CommandLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

await CommandLoader.load<CoreInteractionTypes>({ bot, path: './dist/commands' });
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot, CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/http';
declare const bot: NyxBot<any>;
// ---cut---
import { CommandLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

await CommandLoader.load<CoreInteractionTypes>({ bot, path: './dist/commands' });
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

Pass `register: false` to handle registration yourself:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot, DjsInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
declare const bot: NyxBot<any>;
// ---cut---
import { CommandLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

const commands = await CommandLoader.load<DjsInteractionTypes>({
  bot,
  path: './dist/commands',
  register: false,
});

bot.getCommandManager().addCommands(...commands);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot, CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
declare const bot: NyxBot<any>;
// ---cut---
import { CommandLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

const commands = await CommandLoader.load<CoreInteractionTypes>({
  bot,
  path: './dist/commands',
  register: false,
});

bot.getCommandManager().addCommands(...commands);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot, CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/http';
declare const bot: NyxBot<any>;
// ---cut---
import { CommandLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

const commands = await CommandLoader.load<CoreInteractionTypes>({
  bot,
  path: './dist/commands',
  register: false,
});

bot.getCommandManager().addCommands(...commands);
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Writing commands for the loader [#writing-commands-for-the-loader]

<Tabs items={['Top-level', 'Child']}>
<Tab value="Top-level">

Top-level commands (standalone, parent, context menu) are instantiated with no constructor arguments:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractStandaloneCommand } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import type { Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { SlashCommandBuilder, type ChatInputCommandInteraction } from 'discord.js';

export class PingCommand extends AbstractStandaloneCommand {
  protected readonly data = new SlashCommandBuilder()
    .setName('ping')
    .setDescription('Replies with pong')
    .toJSON();

  async execute(interaction: ChatInputCommandInteraction, meta: Metadata) {
    await interaction.reply('Pong!');
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractStandaloneCommand } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import type { Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import type { ToEventProps, APIChatInputApplicationCommandInteraction } from '@discordjs/core';
import { SlashCommandBuilder } from 'discord.js';

export class PingCommand extends AbstractStandaloneCommand {
  protected readonly data = new SlashCommandBuilder()
    .setName('ping')
    .setDescription('Replies with pong')
    .toJSON();

  async execute(interaction: ToEventProps<APIChatInputApplicationCommandInteraction>, meta: Metadata) {
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

Alternatively, you can specify a `static create(bot)` factory:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractStandaloneCommand } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import type { Metadata, NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { SlashCommandBuilder } from 'discord.js';

export class PingCommand extends AbstractStandaloneCommand {
  protected readonly data = new SlashCommandBuilder()
    .setName('ping')
    .setDescription('Replies with pong')
    .toJSON();

  public static create(bot: NyxBot<any>) {
    return new PingCommand();
  }

  // ...
  // ---cut-start---
  public async execute(interaction: any, meta: Metadata) {}
  // ---cut-end---
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractStandaloneCommand } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import type { Metadata, NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import { SlashCommandBuilder } from 'discord.js';

export class PingCommand extends AbstractStandaloneCommand {
  protected readonly data = new SlashCommandBuilder()
    .setName('ping')
    .setDescription('Replies with pong')
    .toJSON();

  public static create(bot: NyxBot<any>) {
    return new PingCommand();
  }

  // ...
  // ---cut-start---
  public async execute(interaction: any, meta: Metadata) {}
  // ---cut-end---
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { AbstractStandaloneCommand } from '@nyx-discord/http';

```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

</Tab>
<Tab value="Child">

Child commands (subcommands and subcommand groups) must accept a `parent` argument in their constructor:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSubCommand } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import type { AbstractParentCommand, AbstractSubCommandGroup, Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder, type ChatInputCommandInteraction } from 'discord.js';

export class BanCommand extends AbstractSubCommand {
  data = new SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder()
    .setName('ban')
    .setDescription('Ban a user')
    .toJSON();

  constructor(parent: AbstractParentCommand | AbstractSubCommandGroup) {
    super(parent);
  }

  async execute(interaction: ChatInputCommandInteraction, meta: Metadata) {
    // ...
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSubCommand } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import type { AbstractParentCommand, AbstractSubCommandGroup, Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import type { ToEventProps, APIChatInputApplicationCommandInteraction } from '@discordjs/core';
import { SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder } from 'discord.js';

export class BanCommand extends AbstractSubCommand {
  data = new SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder()
    .setName('ban')
    .setDescription('Ban a user')
    .toJSON();

  constructor(parent: AbstractParentCommand | AbstractSubCommandGroup) {
    super(parent);
  }

  async execute(interaction: ToEventProps<APIChatInputApplicationCommandInteraction>, meta: Metadata) {
    // ...
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSubCommand } from '@nyx-discord/http';
import type { AbstractParentCommand, AbstractSubCommandGroup, Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/http';
import type { ToEventProps, APIChatInputApplicationCommandInteraction } from '@discordjs/core';
import { SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder } from 'discord.js';

export class BanCommand extends AbstractSubCommand {
  data = new SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder()
    .setName('ban')
    .setDescription('Ban a user')
    .toJSON();

  constructor(parent: AbstractParentCommand | AbstractSubCommandGroup) {
    super(parent);
  }

  async execute(interaction: ToEventProps<APIChatInputApplicationCommandInteraction>, meta: Metadata) {
    // ...
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

Alternatively, you can specify a `static create(bot, parent)` factory:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSubCommand } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import type { AbstractParentCommand, AbstractSubCommandGroup, NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder } from 'discord.js';

export class BanCommand extends AbstractSubCommand {
  protected readonly data = new SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder()
    .setName('ban')
    .setDescription('Ban a user')
    .toJSON();

  public static create(bot: NyxBot<any>, parent: AbstractParentCommand | AbstractSubCommandGroup) {
    return new BanCommand(parent);
  }

  // ...
  // ---cut-start---
  public async execute() {}
  // ---cut-end---
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSubCommand } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import type { AbstractParentCommand, AbstractSubCommandGroup, NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import { SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder } from 'discord.js';

export class BanCommand extends AbstractSubCommand {
  protected readonly data = new SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder()
    .setName('ban')
    .setDescription('Ban a user')
    .toJSON();

  public static create(bot: NyxBot<any>, parent: AbstractParentCommand | AbstractSubCommandGroup) {
    return new BanCommand(parent);
  }

  // ...
  // ---cut-start---
  public async execute() {}
  // ---cut-end---
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSubCommand } from '@nyx-discord/http';
import type { AbstractParentCommand, AbstractSubCommandGroup, NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/http';
import { SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder } from 'discord.js';

export class BanCommand extends AbstractSubCommand {
  protected readonly data = new SlashCommandSubcommandBuilder()
    .setName('ban')
    .setDescription('Ban a user')
    .toJSON();

  public static create(bot: NyxBot<any>, parent: AbstractParentCommand | AbstractSubCommandGroup) {
    return new BanCommand(parent);
  }

  // ...
  // ---cut-start---
  public async execute() {}
  // ---cut-end---
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

</Tab>
</Tabs>

The loader will call `static create` instead of the constructor if it exists. This allows you to access the bot instance,
or add logic, for example to inject services or other dependencies with a DI container.


# Events (https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/loaders/events)

<Callout type="warn">It's recommended to read the [Events Overview](../use/events) and [Event Subscribers](../events/subscribers) pages first.</Callout>

The <DocsLink pkg="loaders" name="EventLoader" decorated={false} /> scans a directory for event subscriber classes and returns them grouped into six typed arrays.

## Folder structure [#folder-structure]

There is no enforced folder structure, any file in any subdirectory at any depth will be classified by the subscriber class it extends:
- <DocsLink pkg="djs" name="AbstractDJSClientSubscriber" decorated={false} /> for Discord.js client events
- <DocsLink pkg="base" name="AbstractCommandSubscriber" decorated={false} /> for command manager events
- <DocsLink pkg="base" name="AbstractServiceSubscriber" decorated={false} /> for bot service events
- <DocsLink pkg="base" name="AbstractPluginSubscriber" decorated={false} /> for plugin manager events
- <DocsLink pkg="base" name="AbstractBusSubscriber" decorated={false} /> for event bus events
- <DocsLink pkg="base" name="AbstractScheduleSubscriber" decorated={false} /> for schedule manager events

A recommended convention:

<Files>
  <Folder name="dist/events" defaultOpen>
    <Folder name="client" defaultOpen>
      <File name="ready.js" />
    </Folder>
    <Folder name="command" defaultOpen>
      <File name="command-add.js" />
    </Folder>
    <Folder name="service" defaultOpen>
      <File name="service-start.js" />
    </Folder>
    <Folder name="plugin" defaultOpen>
      <File name="plugin-add.js" />
    </Folder>
    <Folder name="bus" defaultOpen>
      <File name="subscriber-add.js" />
    </Folder>
    <Folder name="schedule" defaultOpen>
      <File name="schedule-add.js" />
    </Folder>
  </Folder>
</Files>

## Usage [#usage]

By default, events are automatically subscribed to the appropriate buses:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { EventLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

await EventLoader.load({ bot, path: './dist/events' });
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { EventLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

await EventLoader.load({ bot, path: './dist/events' });
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/http';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { EventLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

await EventLoader.load({ bot, path: './dist/events' });
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

Pass `register: false` to handle registration yourself:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { EventLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

const events = await EventLoader.load({
  bot,
  path: './dist/events',
  register: false,
});

await bot.subscribeToClient(...events.client);
await bot.getCommandManager().subscribe(...events.command);
await bot.getService().subscribe(...events.service);
await bot.getPluginManager().subscribe(...events.plugin);
await bot.getScheduleManager().subscribe(...events.schedule);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { EventLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

const events = await EventLoader.load({
  bot,
  path: './dist/events',
  register: false,
});

await bot.subscribeToClient(...events.client);
await bot.getCommandManager().subscribe(...events.command);
await bot.getService().subscribe(...events.service);
await bot.getPluginManager().subscribe(...events.plugin);
await bot.getScheduleManager().subscribe(...events.schedule);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/http';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { EventLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

const events = await EventLoader.load({
  bot,
  path: './dist/events',
  register: false,
});

await bot.subscribeToClient(...events.client);
await bot.getCommandManager().subscribe(...events.command);
await bot.getService().subscribe(...events.service);
await bot.getPluginManager().subscribe(...events.plugin);
await bot.getScheduleManager().subscribe(...events.schedule);
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

EventBus subscribers (`events.bus`) cannot be registered automatically, so you need to attach them manually


## Writing subscribers for the loader [#writing-subscribers-for-the-loader]

Any class extending one of the six abstract subscriber base classes will be detected:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractDJSClientSubscriber, type Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import type { Client } from 'discord.js';

export class ReadySubscriber extends AbstractDJSClientSubscriber<'ready'> {
  protected readonly event = 'ready' as const;

  public handleEvent(meta: Metadata, client: Client<true>) {
    console.log(`Bot logged in as ${client.user.tag}`);
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractCoreClientSubscriber, type Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import { type ToEventProps, type GatewayReadyDispatchData, GatewayDispatchEvents } from '@discordjs/core';

export class ReadySubscriber extends AbstractCoreClientSubscriber<typeof GatewayDispatchEvents.Ready> {
  protected readonly event = GatewayDispatchEvents.Ready;

  public handleEvent(meta: Metadata, payload: ToEventProps<GatewayReadyDispatchData>) {
    console.log(`Bot logged in as ${payload.data.user.username}`);
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractCoreClientSubscriber, type Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/http';
import { type APIInteraction, type ToEventProps, GatewayDispatchEvents } from '@discordjs/core';

// gateway events like Ready never fire over HTTP, but interactions do
export class InteractionLogSubscriber extends AbstractCoreClientSubscriber<typeof GatewayDispatchEvents.InteractionCreate> {
  protected readonly event = GatewayDispatchEvents.InteractionCreate;

  public handleEvent(meta: Metadata, payload: ToEventProps<APIInteraction>) {
    console.log(`Received interaction ${payload.data.id}`);
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

<Callout>
Top-level subscribers are instantiated with <code>new Class()</code> (no arguments). Subscribers don't receive a parent instance.
</Callout>

Alternatively, you can specify a `static create(bot)` factory:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractDJSClientSubscriber } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import type { NyxBot, Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import type { Client } from 'discord.js';

export class ReadySubscriber extends AbstractDJSClientSubscriber<'ready'> {
  protected readonly event = 'ready' as const;

  public static create(bot: NyxBot) {
    return new ReadySubscriber();
  }

  // ...
  // ---cut-start---
  public handleEvent(meta: Metadata, client: Client<true>) {}
  // ---cut-end---
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractCoreClientSubscriber } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import type { Bot, Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import { type ToEventProps, type GatewayReadyDispatchData, GatewayDispatchEvents } from '@discordjs/core';

export class ReadySubscriber extends AbstractCoreClientSubscriber<typeof GatewayDispatchEvents.Ready> {
  protected readonly event = GatewayDispatchEvents.Ready;

  public static create(bot: Bot) {
    return new ReadySubscriber();
  }

  // ...
  // ---cut-start---
  public handleEvent(meta: Metadata, payload: ToEventProps<GatewayReadyDispatchData>) {}
  // ---cut-end---
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractCoreClientSubscriber } from '@nyx-discord/http';
import type { Bot, Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/http';
import { type APIInteraction, type ToEventProps, GatewayDispatchEvents } from '@discordjs/core';

export class InteractionLogSubscriber extends AbstractCoreClientSubscriber<typeof GatewayDispatchEvents.InteractionCreate> {
  protected readonly event = GatewayDispatchEvents.InteractionCreate;

  public static create(bot: Bot) {
    return new InteractionLogSubscriber();
  }

  // ...
  // ---cut-start---
  public handleEvent(meta: Metadata, payload: ToEventProps<APIInteraction>) {}
  // ---cut-end---
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

The loader will call this method instead of the constructor if it exists. This allows you to access the bot instance,
or add logic, for example to inject services or other dependencies with a DI container.


# Overview (https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/loaders)

The [`@nyx-discord/loaders`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nyx-discord/loaders) package provides directory-scanning loaders that automatically discover and instantiate your commands, event subscribers, and schedules from compiled output directories.

Instead of manually importing and registering every project file, you point a loader at a directory and it scans `.js` / `.mjs` files, instantiates them, adds them to the Bot, and returns them.

## Installation [#installation]

<Steps>
<Step>

### Installing [#installing]

```npm
npm i @nyx-discord/loaders
```

</Step>
<Step>

### Usage [#usage]

Each loader is exposed as a single `load()` method:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { CommandLoader, EventLoader, ScheduleLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

const commands = await CommandLoader.load({ bot, path: './dist/commands' });
//    ^?

const events = await EventLoader.load({ bot, path: './dist/events' });
//    ^?

const schedules = await ScheduleLoader.load({ bot, path: './dist/schedules' });
//    ^?
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { CommandLoader, EventLoader, ScheduleLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

const commands = await CommandLoader.load({ bot, path: './dist/commands' });
//    ^?

const events = await EventLoader.load({ bot, path: './dist/events' });
//    ^?

const schedules = await ScheduleLoader.load({ bot, path: './dist/schedules' });
//    ^?
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/http';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { CommandLoader, EventLoader, ScheduleLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

const commands = await CommandLoader.load({ bot, path: './dist/commands' });
//    ^?

const events = await EventLoader.load({ bot, path: './dist/events' });
//    ^?

const schedules = await ScheduleLoader.load({ bot, path: './dist/schedules' });
//    ^?
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

These returned objects are already added by the loader, they are only returned for informational purposes.

</Step>
</Steps>

## Options [#options]

All loaders share a common options interface:

```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
// ---cut---
type LoaderOptions = {
  /** The bot to load objects for. Also passed to static create() methods. */
  bot: NyxBot;
  /** The directory to scan for .js / .mjs files. */
  path: string;
  /**
   * Whether to auto-register loaded objects with the bot.
   * @default true
   */
  register?: boolean;
  /**
   * Optional filter to include only specific files by their absolute path.
   * Files returning false are silently skipped.
   */
  filter?: (filePath: string) => boolean;
};
```

### `register` [#register]

Set to `false` to skip automatic registration and handle it yourself:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { CommandLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

const commands = await CommandLoader.load({
  bot,
  path: './dist/commands',
  register: false,
});
bot.getCommandManager().addCommands(...commands);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { CommandLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

const commands = await CommandLoader.load({
  bot,
  path: './dist/commands',
  register: false,
});
bot.getCommandManager().addCommands(...commands);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/http';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { CommandLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

const commands = await CommandLoader.load({
  bot,
  path: './dist/commands',
  register: false,
});
bot.getCommandManager().addCommands(...commands);
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

### `filter` [#filter]

Filter files by their absolute path before they are imported. Useful for excluding tests, dev-only files, or selectively loading subsets:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { EventLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

const events = await EventLoader.load({
  bot,
  path: './dist/events',
  filter: (file) => !file.includes('.test.') && !file.includes('.spec.'),
});
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { EventLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

const events = await EventLoader.load({
  bot,
  path: './dist/events',
  filter: (file) => !file.includes('.test.') && !file.includes('.spec.'),
});
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/http';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { EventLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

const events = await EventLoader.load({
  bot,
  path: './dist/events',
  filter: (file) => !file.includes('.test.') && !file.includes('.spec.'),
});
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

The filter is applied before any file is imported, making it efficient for excluding large numbers of files.


# Schedules (https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/loaders/schedules)

The <DocsLink pkg="loaders" name="ScheduleLoader" decorated={false} /> is the simplest loader. It scans a directory recursively for any class extending <DocsLink pkg="base" name="AbstractSchedule" decorated={false} />, instantiates them, and returns a flat <DocsLink pkg="base" name="Schedule" decorated={false} />[].

## Folder structure [#folder-structure]

Any `.js` or `.mjs` file at any depth that exports a class extending <DocsLink pkg="base" name="AbstractSchedule" decorated={false} /> will be picked up:

<Files>
  <Folder name="dist/schedules" defaultOpen>
    <File name="daily.js" />
    <File name="weekly.js" />
    <Folder name="cleanup" defaultOpen>
      <File name="prune-messages.js" />
      <File name="archive-logs.js" />
    </Folder>
  </Folder>
</Files>

## Usage [#usage]

By default, schedules are automatically registered via `scheduleManager.addSchedule()`:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { ScheduleLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

await ScheduleLoader.load({ bot, path: './dist/schedules' });
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { ScheduleLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

await ScheduleLoader.load({ bot, path: './dist/schedules' });
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/http';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { ScheduleLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

await ScheduleLoader.load({ bot, path: './dist/schedules' });
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

Pass `register: false` to handle registration yourself:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { ScheduleLoader } from '@nyx-discord/loaders';

const schedules = await ScheduleLoader.load({
  bot,
  path: './dist/schedules',
  register: false,
});

for (const schedule of schedules) {
  await bot.getScheduleManager().addSchedule(schedule);
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

  bot,
  path: './dist/schedules',
  register: false,
});

  await bot.getScheduleManager().addSchedule(schedule);
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash

```
  </Tab>

## Writing schedules for the loader [#writing-schedules-for-the-loader]

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSchedule } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import type { Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

export class DailyReport extends AbstractSchedule {
  protected readonly interval = '0 0 * * *'; // Every day at midnight

  public async tick(meta: Metadata) {
    // Send daily report...
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>

  </Tab>

<Callout>
Schedules are instantiated with <code>new Class()</code> (no arguments). They don't receive a parent instance.
</Callout>

Alternatively, you can specify a `static create(bot)` factory:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSchedule } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import type { Metadata, NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

export class DailyReport extends AbstractSchedule {
  protected readonly interval = '0 0 * * *';

  public static create(bot: NyxBot) {
    return new DailyReport();
  }

  // ...
  // ---cut-start---
  async tick(meta: Metadata) {}
  // ---cut-end---
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSchedule } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import type { Metadata, NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

export class DailyReport extends AbstractSchedule {
  protected readonly interval = '0 0 * * *';

  public static create(bot: NyxBot) {
    return new DailyReport();
  }

  // ...
  // ---cut-start---
  async tick(meta: Metadata) {}
  // ---cut-end---
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSchedule } from '@nyx-discord/http';
import type { Metadata, NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/http';

export class DailyReport extends AbstractSchedule {
  protected readonly interval = '0 0 * * *';

  public static create(bot: NyxBot) {
    return new DailyReport();
  }

  // ...
  // ---cut-start---
  async tick(meta: Metadata) {}
  // ---cut-end---
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

The loader will call this method instead of the constructor if it exists. This allows you to access the bot instance,
or add logic, for example to inject services or other dependencies with a DI container.


# Events (https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/session/events)

<Callout type="warn">It's recommended to read the [Events Overview](../events/index) and [Event Subscribers](../events/subscribers) pages first.</Callout>

The `SessionManager` has an `EventBus` that allows you to listen to events related to sessions.

This is useful for monitoring, logging, or any other custom logic you want to execute when a session starts, updates, etc.

## Events [#events]

The following events are available:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { SessionEventEnum } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

// @noErrors
SessionEventEnum.
//               ^|
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { SessionEventEnum } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

// @noErrors
SessionEventEnum.
//               ^|
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { SessionEventEnum } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

// @noErrors
SessionEventEnum.
//               ^|
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Usage [#usage]

<Steps>
<Step>
### Subscriber creation [#subscriber-creation]

Create a subscriber that will listen to a given event, use the `SessionEventArgs` type for the arguments map. Check the [Event Subscribers](../events/subscribers) page for more information.

</Step>
<Step>
### Subscription [#subscription]

Subscribe to the event using the `SessionManager`'s `subscribe()` method.

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
// ---cut-start---
import { EventSubscriber } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import type { SessionEventArgs, DjsSessionPlugin } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
declare const subscriber: EventSubscriber<SessionEventArgs, keyof SessionEventArgs>;
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
declare const sessionPlugin: DjsSessionPlugin;
// ---cut-end---
await sessionPlugin.subscribe(subscriber);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
// ---cut-start---
import { EventSubscriber } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import type { SessionEventArgs, CoreSessionPlugin } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
declare const subscriber: EventSubscriber<SessionEventArgs, keyof SessionEventArgs>;
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
declare const sessionPlugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
// ---cut-end---
await sessionPlugin.subscribe(subscriber);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
// ---cut-start---
import { EventSubscriber } from '@nyx-discord/http';

declare const sessionPlugin: CoreSessionPlugin;

```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>
</Step>
</Steps>


# Filters (https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/session/filters)

Filters are objects or callbacks that can restrict the execution of a given session. For example:
- A [user filter](#user-filter) that restricts the interaction to the user who started the session
- A [permission filter](#permission-filter) that checks if the user has the required permissions to interact.

Filters receive all the information about the session, the interaction and the execution metadata, and return a boolean indicating whether the session should be executed or not.

Unlike other filterable objects, a session can have two filters: the `startFilter` and the `updateFilter`.

For more general information about filters, you must first read the general [Filters](/use/other/filters) guide.

## Usage [#usage]

<Callout>In this guide we'll use a regular session, but the same applies to the rest.</Callout>

<Steps>
<Step>

### Creation [#creation]

Either:

- Create a class that extends `AbstractSessionStartFilter` or `AbstractSessionUpdateFilter` and implements the `check()` method.
```ts twoslash
import type { Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { AbstractSessionStartFilter, AbstractSessionUpdateFilter } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { Session, SessionUpdateInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

class MyStartFilter extends AbstractSessionStartFilter<unknown> {
  public async check(session: Session<unknown>, meta: Metadata): Promise<boolean> {
    // Do some checks
    return true; // or false if the session should not be executed
  }
}

class MyUpdateFilter extends AbstractSessionUpdateFilter<unknown> {
  public async check(
   session: Session<unknown>,
   interaction: SessionUpdateInteraction,
   meta: Metadata
 ): Promise<boolean> {
    // Do some checks
    return true; // or false if the session should not be executed
  }
}
```
  The type argument is the return type of your session.

- Create a function that returns a boolean or a Promise that resolves to a boolean.

```ts twoslash
import type {
  SessionStartFilterResolvable,
  DjsSessionUpdateFilterResolvable
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

const myStartFilter: SessionStartFilterResolvable<unknown> = async (session, meta) => {
  // Do some checks
  return true; // or false if the session should not be executed
};

const myUpdateFilter: DjsSessionUpdateFilterResolvable<unknown> = async (
  session,
  interaction,
  meta,
) => {
  // Do some checks
  return true; // or false if the session should not be executed
};
```

</Step>
<Step>

### Filter usage [#filter-usage]

Override the `startFilter` or `updateFilter` property in your session:

- If you created a class, instantiate it:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

// ---cut-start---
import { AbstractSessionStartFilter, AbstractSessionUpdateFilter } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
class MyStartFilter extends AbstractSessionStartFilter<unknown> {
  public async check() { return true; }
}
class MyUpdateFilter extends AbstractSessionUpdateFilter<unknown> {
  public async check() { return true; }
}
// ---cut-end---
class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  // ---cut-start---
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
  // ---cut-end---
  protected override readonly startFilter = new MyStartFilter();
  
  protected override readonly updateFilter = new MyUpdateFilter();
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

// ---cut-start---
import { AbstractSessionStartFilter, AbstractSessionUpdateFilter } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

  public async check() { return true; }
}
class MyUpdateFilter extends AbstractSessionUpdateFilter<unknown> {
  public async check() { return true; }
}
// ---cut-end---
class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  // ---cut-start---
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
  // ---cut-end---
  protected override readonly startFilter = new MyStartFilter();
  
  protected override readonly updateFilter = new MyUpdateFilter();
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash

```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

- If you created a function, assign it directly:

## Examples [#examples]

### User Filter [#user-filter]

A filter that restricts the interaction to the user who started the session. This is commonly used in `updateFilter` to prevent other users from interacting with the session.

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSessionUpdateFilter } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { Session, DjsSessionUpdateInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { DjsInteractionTypes, Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

class UserFilter extends AbstractSessionUpdateFilter<unknown> {
  public async check(
    session: Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>,
    interaction: DjsSessionUpdateInteraction,
    meta: Metadata
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const startInteraction = session.getStartInteraction();
    if (!startInteraction) return true;

    // Check if the user who interacted is the same as the one who started the session
    return interaction.user.id === startInteraction.user.id;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSessionUpdateFilter } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { Session, CoreSessionUpdateInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes, Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

class UserFilter extends AbstractSessionUpdateFilter<unknown> {
  public async check(
    session: Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>,
    interaction: CoreSessionUpdateInteraction,
    meta: Metadata
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const startInteraction = session.getStartInteraction();
    if (!startInteraction) return true;

    const user = interaction.data.user ?? interaction.data.member?.user;
    const startUser = startInteraction.data.user ?? startInteraction.data.member?.user;

    // Check if the user who interacted is the same as the one who started the session
    return user?.id === startUser?.id;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSessionUpdateFilter } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { Session, CoreSessionUpdateInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes, Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/http';

class UserFilter extends AbstractSessionUpdateFilter<unknown> {
  public async check(
    session: Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>,
    interaction: CoreSessionUpdateInteraction,
    meta: Metadata
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const startInteraction = session.getStartInteraction();
    if (!startInteraction) return true;

    const user = interaction.data.user ?? interaction.data.member?.user;
    const startUser = startInteraction.data.user ?? startInteraction.data.member?.user;

    // Check if the user who interacted is the same as the one who started the session
    return user?.id === startUser?.id;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

### Permission Filter [#permission-filter]

A permission filter that checks if the user has the required permissions to interact with the session.

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSessionUpdateFilter } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { Session, DjsSessionUpdateInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { DjsInteractionTypes, Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { PermissionFlagsBits } from 'discord.js';

class PermissionFilter extends AbstractSessionUpdateFilter<unknown> {
  protected readonly requiredPermissions: bigint;

  constructor(requiredPermissions: bigint) {
    super();
    this.requiredPermissions = requiredPermissions;
  }

  public async check(
    session: Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>,
    interaction: DjsSessionUpdateInteraction,
    meta: Metadata
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!interaction.member || !interaction.inCachedGuild()) {
      return false;
    }

    return interaction.member.permissions.has(this.requiredPermissions);
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSessionUpdateFilter } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { Session, CoreSessionUpdateInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes, Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import { PermissionFlagsBits } from 'discord.js';

class PermissionFilter extends AbstractSessionUpdateFilter<unknown> {
  protected readonly requiredPermissions: bigint;

  constructor(requiredPermissions: bigint) {
    super();
    this.requiredPermissions = requiredPermissions;
  }

  public async check(
    session: Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>,
    interaction: CoreSessionUpdateInteraction,
    meta: Metadata
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const member = interaction.data.member;
    if (!member) {
      return false;
    }

    const permissions = BigInt(member.permissions);
    return (permissions & this.requiredPermissions) === this.requiredPermissions;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSessionUpdateFilter } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { Session, CoreSessionUpdateInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes, Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/http';
import { PermissionFlagsBits } from 'discord.js';

class PermissionFilter extends AbstractSessionUpdateFilter<unknown> {
  protected readonly requiredPermissions: bigint;

  constructor(requiredPermissions: bigint) {
    super();
    this.requiredPermissions = requiredPermissions;
  }

  public async check(
    session: Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>,
    interaction: CoreSessionUpdateInteraction,
    meta: Metadata
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const member = interaction.data.member;
    if (!member) {
      return false;
    }

    const permissions = BigInt(member.permissions);
    return (permissions & this.requiredPermissions) === this.requiredPermissions;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>


# Overview (https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/session)

The [`@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions) package is an official [plugin](/use/plugins) that provides and manages user interaction sessions.

These are objects that represent an open interaction "session" with a user. You can consider them as a more advanced, opinionated, OOP version of [DJS' Interaction Collectors](https://discordjs.guide/legacy/popular-topics/collectors).

They can be used as an easy way to maintain a "conversation" with a user, and respond to interactions that the user makes to it.

<Callout>
Some examples of sessions are:

* A paginated message that shows a user's moderations, allowing advanced options like filtering by type.
* An interactive message that guides a user step by step to accomplish something, like creating a ticket category.
* A detailed settings message that allows a user to change their server's settings with buttons, modals or select menus.
* In essence, any kind of situation where continuous interaction with a user is needed.
</Callout>

## Quick example [#quick-example]

This example features many components used in the same session. Some required component properties are omitted for brevity.

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { StringSelectMenuBuilder, ButtonBuilder, ActionRowBuilder, ModalBuilder } from 'discord.js';
import type { ButtonInteraction, AnySelectMenuInteraction, ModalSubmitInteraction } from 'discord.js';
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  protected override readonly ttl = 5_000; // End 5 seconds after the last interaction

  public async onStart() {
    // A select menu that updates this session
    const selectMenuId = this.buildCustomId('select');
    const selectMenu = new StringSelectMenuBuilder().setCustomId(selectMenuId);
    const selectRow = new ActionRowBuilder<StringSelectMenuBuilder>().addComponents(selectMenu);

    // A button that updates this session
    const buttonId = this.buildCustomId('button');
    const button = new ButtonBuilder().setCustomId(buttonId);
    const buttonRow = new ActionRowBuilder<ButtonBuilder>().addComponents(button);

    await this.startInteraction.reply({ components: [buttonRow, selectRow] });
  }

  public async onEnd() {
    await this.startInteraction.editReply({
      content: 'Bye from session!',
      components: [],
    });
  }

  protected async handleButton(interaction: ButtonInteraction) {
    const modalId = this.buildCustomId('modal');
    const myModal = new ModalBuilder().setCustomId(modalId);
    await interaction.showModal(myModal);
    return true;
  }

  protected async handleSelectMenu(interaction: AnySelectMenuInteraction) {
    await interaction.reply('You selected: ' + interaction.values[0]);
    return true;
  }

  protected async handleModal(interaction: ModalSubmitInteraction) {
    const name = interaction.fields.getTextInputValue('name');
    await interaction.reply(`Your name is ${name}`);
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { StringSelectMenuBuilder, ButtonBuilder, ActionRowBuilder, ModalBuilder } from '@discordjs/builders';
import { ComponentType } from '@discordjs/core';
import type {
  APIMessageComponentButtonInteraction,
  APIMessageComponentSelectMenuInteraction,
  APIModalSubmitInteraction,
  ModalSubmitActionRowComponent,
  ToEventProps,
} from '@discordjs/core';
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  protected override readonly ttl = 5_000; // End 5 seconds after the last interaction

  public async onStart() {
    // A select menu that updates this session
    const selectMenuId = this.buildCustomId('select');
    const selectMenu = new StringSelectMenuBuilder().setCustomId(selectMenuId);
    const selectRow = new ActionRowBuilder<StringSelectMenuBuilder>().addComponents(selectMenu);

    // A button that updates this session
    const buttonId = this.buildCustomId('button');
    const button = new ButtonBuilder().setCustomId(buttonId);
    const buttonRow = new ActionRowBuilder<ButtonBuilder>().addComponents(button);

    await this.startInteraction.api.interactions.reply(
      this.startInteraction.data.id,
      this.startInteraction.data.token,
      { components: [buttonRow.toJSON(), selectRow.toJSON()] },
    );
  }

  public async onEnd() {
    await this.startInteraction.api.interactions.editReply(
      this.startInteraction.data.application_id,
      this.startInteraction.data.token,
      {
        content: 'Bye from session!',
        components: [],
      },
    );
  }

  protected async handleButton(interaction: ToEventProps<APIMessageComponentButtonInteraction>) {
    const modalId = this.buildCustomId('modal');
    const myModal = new ModalBuilder().setCustomId(modalId);
    await interaction.api.interactions.createModal(
      interaction.data.id,
      interaction.data.token,
      myModal.toJSON(),
    );
    return true;
  }

  protected async handleSelectMenu(interaction: ToEventProps<APIMessageComponentSelectMenuInteraction>) {
    await interaction.api.interactions.reply(
      interaction.data.id,
      interaction.data.token,
      { content: 'You selected: ' + interaction.data.data.values[0] },
    );
    return true;
  }

  protected async handleModal(interaction: ToEventProps<APIModalSubmitInteraction>) {
    const name = interaction.data.data.components
      .filter((row): row is ModalSubmitActionRowComponent => row.type === ComponentType.ActionRow)
      .flatMap(row => row.components)
      .find(component => component.custom_id === 'name')?.value;

    await interaction.api.interactions.reply(
      interaction.data.id,
      interaction.data.token,
      { content: `Your name is ${name}` },
    );
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
    );
    return true;
  }
}
```

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import { type ChatInputCommandInteraction } from 'discord.js';
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
class MySession extends AbstractSession {}
// ---cut---
// Can be a command, component or modal interaction
declare const startInteraction: ChatInputCommandInteraction;

const id = 'mySessionId'; // Should be short and randomly generated, nanoid is good for this
const session = new MySession({ bot, id, startInteraction });
await session.start();

// Wait for the session to end
await session.getEndPromise();

// Wait 3 seconds
await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 3000)); 

await startInteraction.editReply('Bye from command!');
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>

After filling the modal and components with values, this will look like this:

<video width="100%" controls muted>
  <source src={`${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH ?? ''}/docs/session_showcase.mp4`} type="video/mp4" />
  Your browser does not support the video tag.
</video>

Notice how:
- The plugin routes interactions belonging to the session to the appropiate handler.
- The session finishes automatically after the `ttl` has passed since the last interaction.
- The session starter is able to wait for the session to end, and then do what it needs to, like reply further.

We'll dive deeper on what each of the methods do later, but this should be enough to give you an idea of how sessions work.

## Installation [#installation]

<Steps>
<Step>

### Installing [#installing]

```npm
npm i @nyx-discord/plugin-sessions
```

</Step>

<Step>

### Registering [#registering]

Instantiate and register it to your bot's plugin manager:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { type NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { DjsSessionPlugin } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

await bot.getPluginManager().register(DjsSessionPlugin.create());
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>

```ts twoslash
import { type NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut---
import { CoreSessionPlugin } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

await bot.getPluginManager().register(CoreSessionPlugin.create());
```
  </Tab>

# Limits (https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/session/limits)

Session limits cap how many concurrent sessions a user, guild, or channel can have for a given session type.
They are enforced **before** a session starts, and they are registered externally via `plugin.getSessionLimits().register(...)`.

<Callout type="warn">
Limits must be registered and removed **before** starting. Calling `register()` or `remove()` after starting the bot throws an `IllegalStateError`.
</Callout>

## Registration [#registration]

Register limits through `plugin.getSessionLimits().register()` before starting the plugin. You can use either a plain object or a builder.

<Tabs items={['Plain Object', 'Builder']}>
<Tab>

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { DjsSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, AbstractSession, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { DjsSessionLimit } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { DjsInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

declare const plugin: DjsSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
const limit: DjsSessionLimit = {
  session: MySession,
  rules: [
    {
      max: 1,
      scope: SessionLimitScope.User,
      onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error,
    },
  ],
};

plugin.getSessionLimits().register(limit);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { CoreSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, AbstractSession, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreSessionLimit } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
const limit: CoreSessionLimit = {
  session: MySession,
  rules: [
    {
      max: 1,
      scope: SessionLimitScope.User,
      onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error,
    },
  ],
};

plugin.getSessionLimits().register(limit);
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

</Tab>
<Tab>

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import {
  DjsSessionPlugin,
  DjsSessionLimitBuilder,
  SessionLimitScope,
  SessionExceedAction,
  AbstractSession,
  Session,
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { DjsInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

declare const plugin: DjsSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
const limit = new DjsSessionLimitBuilder()
  .setSession(MySession)
  .addRule((rule) =>
    rule
      .setMax(1)
      .setScope(SessionLimitScope.User)
      .setOnExceed(SessionExceedAction.Error),
  )
  .toSessionLimit();

plugin.getSessionLimits().register(limit);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import {
  CoreSessionPlugin,
  CoreSessionLimitBuilder,
  SessionLimitScope,
  SessionExceedAction,
  AbstractSession,
  Session,
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
const limit = new CoreSessionLimitBuilder()
  .setSession(MySession)
  .addRule((rule) =>
    rule
      .setMax(1)
      .setScope(SessionLimitScope.User)
      .setOnExceed(SessionExceedAction.Error),
  )
  .toSessionLimit();

plugin.getSessionLimits().register(limit);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import {
  CoreSessionPlugin,
  CoreSessionLimitBuilder,
  SessionLimitScope,
  SessionExceedAction,
  AbstractSession,
  Session,
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

  .setSession(MySession)
  .addRule((rule) =>
    rule
      .setMax(1)
      .setScope(SessionLimitScope.User)
      .setOnExceed(SessionExceedAction.Error),
  )
  .toSessionLimit();

plugin.getSessionLimits().register(limit);
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

</Tab>
</Tabs>

<Callout>
You can pass multiple limits to a single `register()` call and register as many limits as needed before the plugin starts.
</Callout>

## Scopes [#scopes]

A scope determines which sessions count toward the limit. Each scope computes a string key from the session's starting interaction.

### User [#user]

One session per user. Multiple users can each have their own session.

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { DjsSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, AbstractSession, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { DjsInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

declare const plugin: DjsSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [{
    max: 1,
    scope: SessionLimitScope.User, // [!code highlight]
    onExceed: SessionExceedAction.displace()
  }],
});
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { CoreSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, AbstractSession, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [{
    max: 1,
    scope: SessionLimitScope.User, // [!code highlight]
    onExceed: SessionExceedAction.displace()
  }],
});
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { CoreSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, AbstractSession, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/http';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [{
    max: 1,
    scope: SessionLimitScope.User, // [!code highlight]
    onExceed: SessionExceedAction.displace()
  }],
});
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

<Callout>
  **Example:** An interactive `/counter` command. A user opens a session with increment/decrement buttons.
  Limit of 1 per user prevents duplicate counter sessions, and opening a second counter silently displaces the first.
</Callout>

### Guild [#guild]

One session per guild. DMs are grouped under the key `'dm'`.

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { DjsSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, AbstractSession, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { DjsInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

declare const plugin: DjsSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [{
    max: 3,
    scope: SessionLimitScope.Guild, // [!code highlight]
    onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error
  }],
});
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { CoreSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, AbstractSession, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [{
    max: 3,
    scope: SessionLimitScope.Guild, // [!code highlight]
    onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error
  }],
});
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { CoreSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, AbstractSession, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/http';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [{
    max: 3,
    scope: SessionLimitScope.Guild, // [!code highlight]
    onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error
  }],
});
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

<Callout>
  **Example:** A ticket wizard. The wizard walks the user through category, priority, and description steps. Limit of 3 per guild prevents a noisy server from spawning dozens of incomplete wizards.
</Callout>

### Channel [#channel]

One session per channel. Sessions without a `channelId` get the key `'unknown'` (at the time of writing, never the case,
but it's still covered for future-proofing).

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { DjsSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, AbstractSession, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { DjsInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

declare const plugin: DjsSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [{
    max: 1,
    scope: SessionLimitScope.Channel, // [!code highlight]
    onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error
  }],
});
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { CoreSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, AbstractSession, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---

  session: MySession,
  rules: [{
    max: 1,
    scope: SessionLimitScope.Channel, // [!code highlight]
    onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error
  }],
});
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash

  session: MySession,
  rules: [{
    max: 1,
    scope: SessionLimitScope.Channel, // [!code highlight]
    onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error
  }],
});
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

<Callout>
  **Example:** A live poll session with reaction buttons. Limit of 1 per channel ensures only one active poll runs in a channel at a time.
</Callout>

### Composite [#composite]

Combine multiple scopes. For example, one session per user per guild:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { DjsSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, AbstractSession, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { DjsInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

declare const plugin: DjsSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [
    {
      max: 1,
      scope: SessionLimitScope.composite(SessionLimitScope.User, SessionLimitScope.Guild), // [!code highlight]
      onExceed: SessionExceedAction.displace(),
    },
  ],
});
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { CoreSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, AbstractSession, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [
    {
      max: 1,
      scope: SessionLimitScope.composite(SessionLimitScope.User, SessionLimitScope.Guild), // [!code highlight]
      onExceed: SessionExceedAction.displace(),
    },
  ],
});
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { CoreSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, AbstractSession, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
```
