```ts twoslash
  session: MySession,
  rules: [
    {
      max: 1,
      scope: SessionLimitScope.composite(SessionLimitScope.User, SessionLimitScope.Guild), // [!code highlight]
      onExceed: SessionExceedAction.displace(),
    },
  ],
});
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

<Callout>
  **Example:** An embedded game like tic-tac-toe. Limit of 1 per user per guild. A user can play one game in each server they're in, but not two games in the same server.
</Callout>

### Custom [#custom]

Provide an arbitrary function that returns a string key:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { DjsSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, AbstractSession, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { DjsInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

declare const plugin: DjsSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => AbstractSession<unknown>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [
    {
      max: 1,
      scope: SessionLimitScope.custom((s: Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>) => s.getStartInteraction().locale), // [!code highlight]
      onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error,
    },
  ],
});
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { CoreSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, AbstractSession, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => AbstractSession<unknown>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [
    {
      max: 1,
      scope: SessionLimitScope.custom((s: Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>) => s.getStartInteraction().data.locale), // [!code highlight]
      onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error,
    },
  ],
});
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash

  session: MySession,
  rules: [
    {

      onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error,
    },

```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

<Callout>
  **Example:** A translation-review session. Users with the same Discord locale share one review session across the
  bot, and only one reviewer per language at a time.
</Callout>

## Actions [#actions]

An action defines what happens when the limit is exceeded.

### Error [#error]

Throws `SessionLimitExceededError`, which you can catch and reply to the user:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { DjsSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, SessionLimitExceededError, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { DjsInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import type { ChatInputCommandInteraction } from 'discord.js';

declare const plugin: DjsSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>;
declare const session: Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>;
declare const interaction: ChatInputCommandInteraction;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [{
    max: 1,
    scope: SessionLimitScope.User,
    onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error // [!code highlight]
  }],
});

// In your command handler:
try {
  await session.start();
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof SessionLimitExceededError) {
    await interaction.reply({ content: 'You already have an active session.', ephemeral: true });
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { CoreSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, SessionLimitExceededError, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import type { ChatInputCommandInteraction } from 'discord.js';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
declare const session: Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
declare const interaction: ChatInputCommandInteraction;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [{
    max: 1,
    scope: SessionLimitScope.User,
    onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error // [!code highlight]
  }],
});

// In your command handler:
try {
  await session.start();
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof SessionLimitExceededError) {
    await interaction.reply({ content: 'You already have an active session.', ephemeral: true });
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { CoreSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, SessionLimitExceededError, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/http';
import type { ChatInputCommandInteraction } from 'discord.js';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;

declare const session: Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
declare const interaction: ChatInputCommandInteraction;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [{
    max: 1,
    scope: SessionLimitScope.User,
    onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error // [!code highlight]
  }],
});

// In your command handler:
try {
  await session.start();
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof SessionLimitExceededError) {
    await interaction.reply({ content: 'You already have an active session.', ephemeral: true });
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

<Callout>
  **Example:** A profile setup wizard with max 1 per user. The second attempt throws, and the handler catches to reply with a friendly ephemeral message.
</Callout>

### Displace [#displace]

Evicts an existing session to make room. The displaced session receives `SessionEndCodes.Displaced`.

The existing session is only ended **after** the new one has started. If the new session doesn't start (its start filter
rejects it, a middleware stops it, or its `onStart()` throws), the existing session keeps running. Only running sessions
are displaced: if every session in the scope is still starting, the new one is rejected with `SessionLimitExceededError`.

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { DjsSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { DjsInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

declare const plugin: DjsSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>;
declare const session: Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
// Default: replaces the first existing session
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [{
    max: 1,
    scope: SessionLimitScope.User,
    onExceed: SessionExceedAction.displace() // [!code highlight]
  }],
});

// With a custom pick function, e.g. oldest first:
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [
    {
      max: 1,
      scope: SessionLimitScope.User,
      onExceed: SessionExceedAction.displace((existing: Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>[]) => // [!code highlight]
        existing.reduce((a, b) => ( // [!code highlight]
          a.getStartInteraction().createdAt < b.getStartInteraction().createdAt ? a : b // [!code highlight]
        )), // [!code highlight]
      ), // [!code highlight]
    },
  ],
});
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { CoreSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
declare const session: Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
// Default: replaces the first existing session
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [{
    max: 1,
    scope: SessionLimitScope.User,
    onExceed: SessionExceedAction.displace() // [!code highlight]
  }],
});

// With a custom pick function, e.g. oldest first:
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [
    {
      max: 1,
      scope: SessionLimitScope.User,
      onExceed: SessionExceedAction.displace((existing: Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>[]) => // [!code highlight]
        existing.reduce((a, b) => ( // [!code highlight]
          a.getStartInteraction().data.id < b.getStartInteraction().data.id ? a : b // [!code highlight]
        )), // [!code highlight]
      ), // [!code highlight]
    },
  ],
});
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { CoreSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/http';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
declare const session: Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---

  session: MySession,
  rules: [{
    max: 1,
    scope: SessionLimitScope.User,
    onExceed: SessionExceedAction.displace() // [!code highlight]
  }],
});

  session: MySession,
  rules: [
    {
      max: 1,
      scope: SessionLimitScope.User,
      onExceed: SessionExceedAction.displace((existing: Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>[]) => // [!code highlight]
        existing.reduce((a, b) => ( // [!code highlight]
          a.getStartInteraction().data.id < b.getStartInteraction().data.id ? a : b // [!code highlight]
        )), // [!code highlight]
      ), // [!code highlight]
    },
  ],
});
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

<Callout>
  **Example:** An interactive counter. The user runs `/counter`, and if one already exists, it's silently replaced.
  The old session's `onEnd()` fires, its buttons are disabled, and the promise resolves with `SessionEndCodes.Displaced`.
</Callout>

### Custom [#custom-1]

Full control via `ExceedDecision`:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { DjsSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { SessionExceedContext, DjsSessionLimit } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { DjsInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

declare const plugin: DjsSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
const limit: DjsSessionLimit = {
  session: MySession,
  rules: [
    {
      max: 3,
      scope: SessionLimitScope.Guild,
      onExceed: SessionExceedAction.custom(async (ctx: SessionExceedContext<DjsInteractionTypes>) => { // [!code highlight]
        await ctx.attempted.getStartInteraction().reply({ // [!code highlight]
          content: `Queue full (${ctx.existing.length} dashboards active). Try later.`, // [!code highlight]
          ephemeral: true, // [!code highlight]
        }); // [!code highlight]
        return { proceed: false }; // [!code highlight]
      }), // [!code highlight]
    },
  ],
};
plugin.getSessionLimits().register(limit);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { CoreSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { SessionExceedContext, CoreSessionLimit } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
const limit: CoreSessionLimit = {
  session: MySession,
  rules: [
    {
      max: 3,
      scope: SessionLimitScope.Guild,
      onExceed: SessionExceedAction.custom(async (ctx: SessionExceedContext<CoreInteractionTypes>) => { // [!code highlight]
        await ctx.attempted.getStartInteraction().api.interactions.reply( // [!code highlight]
          ctx.attempted.getStartInteraction().data.id, // [!code highlight]
          ctx.attempted.getStartInteraction().data.token, // [!code highlight]
          { content: `Queue full (${ctx.existing.length} dashboards active). Try later.` } // [!code highlight]
        ); // [!code highlight]
        return { proceed: false }; // [!code highlight]
      }), // [!code highlight]
    },
  ],
};
plugin.getSessionLimits().register(limit);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { CoreSessionPlugin, SessionLimitScope, SessionExceedAction, Session } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { SessionExceedContext, CoreSessionLimit } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/http';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
const limit: CoreSessionLimit = {
  session: MySession,
  rules: [
    {
      max: 3,
      scope: SessionLimitScope.Guild,
      onExceed: SessionExceedAction.custom(async (ctx: SessionExceedContext<CoreInteractionTypes>) => { // [!code highlight]
        await ctx.attempted.getStartInteraction().api.interactions.reply( // [!code highlight]
          ctx.attempted.getStartInteraction().data.id, // [!code highlight]
          ctx.attempted.getStartInteraction().data.token, // [!code highlight]
          { content: `Queue full (${ctx.existing.length} dashboards active). Try later.` } // [!code highlight]
        ); // [!code highlight]
        return { proceed: false }; // [!code highlight]
      }), // [!code highlight]
    },
  ],
};
plugin.getSessionLimits().register(limit);
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

- `{ proceed: false }`: throws `SessionLimitExceededError`
- `{ proceed: true, displace: null }`: allows the session without eviction (bypassing the limit)
- `{ proceed: true, displace: session }`: evicts that specific session and starts

<Callout>
  **Example:** An admin dashboard with max 3 per guild. On exceed, the custom handler replies with a queue
  status message and blocks the new session.
</Callout>

## Predicates [#predicates]

When you need different limits for the same session type (e.g. premium vs free users), use predicates.

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { TypedFields, type DjsInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import {
  DjsSessionPlugin,
  SessionLimitScope,
  SessionExceedAction,
  AbstractSession,
  Session,
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

const Tier = TypedFields.create<'premium' | 'free'>('Tier');

declare const plugin: DjsSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register(
  {
    session: MySession,
    predicate: (session: Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>, meta) => Tier.get(meta) === 'premium', // [!code highlight]
    rules: [{ max: 5, scope: SessionLimitScope.User, onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error }],
  },
  {
    session: MySession,
    predicate: (session: Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>, meta) => Tier.get(meta) !== 'premium', // [!code highlight]
    rules: [{ max: 1, scope: SessionLimitScope.User, onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error }],
  },
);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { TypedFields, type CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import {
  CoreSessionPlugin,
  SessionLimitScope,
  SessionExceedAction,
  AbstractSession,
  Session,
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

const Tier = TypedFields.create<'premium' | 'free'>('Tier');

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register(
  {
    session: MySession,
    predicate: (session: Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>, meta) => Tier.get(meta) === 'premium', // [!code highlight]
    rules: [{ max: 5, scope: SessionLimitScope.User, onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error }],
  },
  {
    session: MySession,
    predicate: (session: Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>, meta) => Tier.get(meta) !== 'premium', // [!code highlight]
    rules: [{ max: 1, scope: SessionLimitScope.User, onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error }],
  },
);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { TypedFields, type CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/http';
import {
  CoreSessionPlugin,
  SessionLimitScope,
  SessionExceedAction,
  AbstractSession,
  Session,
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

const Tier = TypedFields.create<'premium' | 'free'>('Tier');

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register(
  {
    session: MySession,
    predicate: (session: Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>, meta) => Tier.get(meta) === 'premium', // [!code highlight]
    rules: [{ max: 5, scope: SessionLimitScope.User, onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error }],
  },
  {
    session: MySession,
    predicate: (session: Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>, meta) => Tier.get(meta) !== 'premium', // [!code highlight]
    rules: [{ max: 1, scope: SessionLimitScope.User, onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error }],
  },
);
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

<Callout type="warn">
If two or more policies for the same constructor match (or all lack a predicate), an `AmbiguousSessionLimitError` is thrown. Make sure predicates are mutually exclusive.
</Callout>

## Inheritance [#inheritance]

Limits are inherited through the prototype chain. When you start a child session, both the parent's and the child's policies are checked (AND semantics).

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import {
  DjsSessionPlugin,
  SessionLimitScope,
  SessionExceedAction,
  Session
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { DjsInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

declare const plugin: DjsSessionPlugin;
declare const ParentSession: new () => Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>;
declare const ChildSession: new () => Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: ParentSession,
  rules: [{ max: 2, scope: SessionLimitScope.Guild, onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error }],
});

plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: ChildSession,
  rules: [{ max: 1, scope: SessionLimitScope.User, onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error }],
});

// Starting a ChildSession checks both policies:
//   1. At most 2 sessions in the guild (from ParentSession)
//   2. At most 1 session per user (from ChildSession)
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import {
  CoreSessionPlugin,
  SessionLimitScope,
  SessionExceedAction,
  Session
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const ParentSession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
declare const ChildSession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: ParentSession,
  rules: [{ max: 2, scope: SessionLimitScope.Guild, onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error }],
});

plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: ChildSession,
  rules: [{ max: 1, scope: SessionLimitScope.User, onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error }],
});

// Starting a ChildSession checks both policies:
//   1. At most 2 sessions in the guild (from ParentSession)
//   2. At most 1 session per user (from ChildSession)
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import {
  CoreSessionPlugin,
  SessionLimitScope,
  SessionExceedAction,
  Session
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { CoreInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/http';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const ParentSession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
declare const ChildSession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: ParentSession,
  rules: [{ max: 2, scope: SessionLimitScope.Guild, onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error }],
});

plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: ChildSession,
  rules: [{ max: 1, scope: SessionLimitScope.User, onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error }],
});

// Starting a ChildSession checks both policies:
//   1. At most 2 sessions in the guild (from ParentSession)
//   2. At most 1 session per user (from ChildSession)
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Multiple Rules [#multiple-rules]

A single policy can define multiple rules. All rules must pass for the session to start.

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import {
  DjsSessionPlugin,
  SessionLimitScope,
  SessionExceedAction,
  AbstractSession,
  Session,
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { DjsInteractionTypes } from '@nyx-discord/djs';

declare const plugin: DjsSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [
    { max: 3, scope: SessionLimitScope.User, onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error },
    { max: 10, scope: SessionLimitScope.Guild, onExceed: SessionExceedAction.displace() },
  ],
});

// Both rules are checked:
//   - At most 3 per user => Error
//   - At most 10 per guild => Displace
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import {
  CoreSessionPlugin,
  SessionLimitScope,
  SessionExceedAction,
  AbstractSession,
  Session,
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

declare const plugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
declare const MySession: new () => Session<unknown, CoreInteractionTypes>;
// ---cut---
plugin.getSessionLimits().register({
  session: MySession,
  rules: [
    { max: 3, scope: SessionLimitScope.User, onExceed: SessionExceedAction.Error },
    { max: 10, scope: SessionLimitScope.Guild, onExceed: SessionExceedAction.displace() },
  ],
});

// Both rules are checked:
//   - At most 3 per user => Error
//   - At most 10 per guild => Displace
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash

```

# Middlewares (https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/session/middlewares)

Middlewares are objects or callbacks that run before any session is executed. They can do some pre-processing logic and store it in the metadata, or even prevent the subscriber from being executed.

Specifically, sessions have two types of middlewares: one for starting sessions, and one for updating them.

For general information about middlewares, you must first read the general [Middlewares](/use/other/middlewares) guide.

## Usage [#usage]

<Steps>
<Step>

### Creation [#creation]

Either:
- Create a class that extends `BaseSessionStartMiddleware` or `BaseSessionUpdateMiddleware` and implements the `check()` method.
```ts twoslash
import {
  AbstractSessionStartMiddleware,
  AbstractSessionUpdateMiddleware
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type {
  DjsInteractionTypes,
  Metadata,
  MiddlewareResponse,
} from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import type { Session, DjsSessionUpdateInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

class MyStartMiddleware extends AbstractSessionStartMiddleware {
  public async check(
    session: Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>,
    meta: Metadata
  ): Promise<MiddlewareResponse> {
    // Do some pre-processing logic
    return this.true();
  }
}

class MyUpdateMiddleware extends AbstractSessionUpdateMiddleware {
  public async check(
    session: Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>,
    interaction: DjsSessionUpdateInteraction,
    meta: Metadata
  ): Promise<MiddlewareResponse> {
    return this.true();
  }
}
```

- Create a function that returns a `MiddlewareResponse`.
```ts twoslash
import type { DjsInteractionTypes, Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import type {
  SessionStartMiddlewareResolvable,
  DjsSessionUpdateMiddlewareResolvable,
  Session,
  DjsSessionUpdateInteraction
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

const myCallbackStartMiddleware: SessionStartMiddlewareResolvable = async (
  session: Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>,
  meta: Metadata
) => {
  // Do some pre-processing logic
  return {
    allowed: true,
    checkNext: true,
  };
};

const myCallbackUpdateMiddleware: DjsSessionUpdateMiddlewareResolvable = async (
  session: Session<unknown, DjsInteractionTypes>,
  interaction: DjsSessionUpdateInteraction,
  meta: Metadata
) => {
  return {
    allowed: true,
    checkNext: true,
  };
};
```

</Step>
<Step>

### Registration [#registration]

Register it to the executor's `MiddlewareList`:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import type {
  AbstractSessionStartMiddleware,
  AbstractSessionUpdateMiddleware,
  SessionStartMiddlewareResolvable,
  DjsSessionUpdateMiddlewareResolvable,
  DjsSessionPlugin
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

declare const MyStartMiddleware: new () => AbstractSessionStartMiddleware;
declare const MyUpdateMiddleware: new () => AbstractSessionUpdateMiddleware;

declare const myCallbackUpdateMiddleware: DjsSessionUpdateMiddlewareResolvable;
declare const myCallbackStartMiddleware: SessionStartMiddlewareResolvable;
declare const sessionPlugin: DjsSessionPlugin;
// ---cut---
const executor = sessionPlugin.getExecutor();

executor.getStartMiddleware().add(new MyStartMiddleware(), myCallbackStartMiddleware);
executor.getUpdateMiddleware().add(new MyUpdateMiddleware(), myCallbackUpdateMiddleware);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import type {
  AbstractSessionStartMiddleware,
  AbstractSessionUpdateMiddleware,
  SessionStartMiddlewareResolvable,
  CoreSessionUpdateMiddlewareResolvable,
  CoreSessionPlugin
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

declare const MyStartMiddleware: new () => AbstractSessionStartMiddleware;
declare const MyUpdateMiddleware: new () => AbstractSessionUpdateMiddleware;

declare const myCallbackUpdateMiddleware: CoreSessionUpdateMiddlewareResolvable;
declare const myCallbackStartMiddleware: SessionStartMiddlewareResolvable;
declare const sessionPlugin: CoreSessionPlugin;
// ---cut---
const executor = sessionPlugin.getExecutor();

executor.getStartMiddleware().add(new MyStartMiddleware(), myCallbackStartMiddleware);
executor.getUpdateMiddleware().add(new MyUpdateMiddleware(), myCallbackUpdateMiddleware);
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash

  AbstractSessionStartMiddleware,

  CoreSessionPlugin

declare const MyUpdateMiddleware: new () => AbstractSessionUpdateMiddleware;

```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

</Step>
</Steps>


# List Pagination Session (https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/session/types/list-pagination-session)

<Callout type="warn">It's recommended to read the [Pagination Session](./pagination-session) page first, all of its features apply to this.</Callout>

A `ListPaginationSession` is a special type of pagination session made to paginate a list of items.

Initially, the item's values are received at the session's constructor. You can also include a refreshing system in the session to refresh the items with their newest state, if desired.

## Creation [#creation]

<Steps>
<Step>

### Creation [#creation-1]
Extend the `AbstractListPaginationSession` class:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractListPaginationSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

// ---cut-start---
// @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
// ---cut-end---
class MyListPaginationSession extends AbstractListPaginationSession<number> {}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractListPaginationSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

// ---cut-start---
// @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
// ---cut-end---
class MyListPaginationSession extends AbstractListPaginationSession<number> {}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { AbstractListPaginationSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

// ---cut-start---
// @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
// ---cut-end---
class MyListPaginationSession extends AbstractListPaginationSession<number> {}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

The first type argument is the type of the items, and the second is the session's return type.

<Callout>
In `updatePage()` you can now use `getCurrentPageItems()`, which is an utility method that calculates and returns the current page's items.
</Callout>

</Step>
<Step>
### Implementation [#implementation]

Implement it the same way you'd implement a `PaginationSession`.

</Step>
<Step>

### Initialization [#initialization]

Instantiate and start your session the same way as a regular one, but passing the list of items:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { AbstractListPaginationSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import { type ChatInputCommandInteraction } from 'discord.js';
declare const startInteraction: ChatInputCommandInteraction;
declare const bot: NyxBot;
declare const id: string;
// @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
class MyListPaginationSession extends AbstractListPaginationSession<number, void> {}
// ---cut---
const session = new MyListPaginationSession({
  bot,
  id,
  startInteraction,
  items: [1, 2, 3, /** ... */]
});
await session.start();
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash

import type { APIChatInputApplicationCommandInteraction, ToEventProps } from '@discordjs/core';
declare const startInteraction: ToEventProps<APIChatInputApplicationCommandInteraction>;
declare const bot: NyxBot;
declare const id: string;
// @ts-expect-error Incomplete example

// ---cut---
```

  </Tab>

  </Tab>

</Step>
</Steps>

## Example [#example]

This example will paginate a list of the currently cached guilds:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import {
  AbstractListPaginationSession,
  type DjsSessionUpdateInteraction,
  type DjsSessionStartInteraction
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import { ContainerBuilder, SectionBuilder, MessageFlags, type Guild } from 'discord.js';

class GuildsPaginationSession extends AbstractListPaginationSession<Guild, void> {
//                                                                  ^^^^^
  constructor(options: {
    bot: NyxBot;
    id: string;
    startInteraction: DjsSessionStartInteraction;
    items: Guild[];
  }) {
    super(options);
  }

  public async onStart() {
    const container = this.generateContainer();
    const row = this.buildBasicPageRow();

    await this.startInteraction.reply({
      components: [container, row],
      flags: MessageFlags.IsComponentsV2,
    });
  }

  protected async updatePage(interaction: DjsSessionUpdateInteraction): Promise<boolean> {
    const container = this.generateContainer();
    const row = this.buildBasicPageRow();

    if ('update' in interaction) {
      await interaction.update({
        components: [container, row],
        flags: MessageFlags.IsComponentsV2,
      });
    }
    return true;
  }

  public async onEnd() {
    const container = this.generateContainer();
    await this.startInteraction.editReply({
      components: [container],
      flags: MessageFlags.IsComponentsV2,
    });
  }

  protected generateContainer(): ContainerBuilder {
    const guilds = this.getCurrentPageItems(); // [!code highlight]
    const container = new ContainerBuilder()
      .addTextDisplayComponents((textDisplay) => textDisplay.setContent('# Guilds'));

    for (const guild of guilds) {
      const icon = guild.iconURL();
      if (icon) {
        container.addSectionComponents((section) => section
          .addTextDisplayComponents((textDisplay) => textDisplay.setContent(guild.name))
          .setThumbnailAccessory((thumbnail) => thumbnail.setURL(icon))
        );
      } else {
        container.addTextDisplayComponents((textDisplay) => textDisplay.setContent(guild.name));
      }
    }

    return container;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import {
  AbstractListPaginationSession,
  type CoreSessionUpdateInteraction,
  type CoreSessionStartInteraction
} from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import { ContainerBuilder, SectionBuilder, MessageFlags, type Guild } from 'discord.js';

class GuildsPaginationSession extends AbstractListPaginationSession<Guild, void> {
//                                                                  ^^^^^
  constructor(options: {
    bot: NyxBot;
    id: string;
    startInteraction: CoreSessionStartInteraction;
    items: Guild[];
  }) {
    super(options);
  }

  public async onStart() {
    const container = this.generateContainer();
    const row = this.buildBasicPageRow();

    await this.startInteraction.api.interactions.reply(
      this.startInteraction.data.id,
      this.startInteraction.data.token,
      { components: [container.toJSON(), row] }
    );
  }

  protected async updatePage(interaction: CoreSessionUpdateInteraction): Promise<boolean> {
    const container = this.generateContainer();
    const row = this.buildBasicPageRow();

    await interaction.api.interactions.updateMessage(
      interaction.data.id,
      interaction.data.token,
      { components: [container.toJSON(), row] }
    );
    return true;
  }

  public async onEnd() {
    const container = this.generateContainer();
    await this.startInteraction.api.interactions.editReply(
      this.startInteraction.data.application_id,
      this.startInteraction.data.token,
      { components: [container.toJSON()] }
    );
  }

  protected generateContainer(): ContainerBuilder {
    const guilds = this.getCurrentPageItems(); // [!code highlight]
    const container = new ContainerBuilder()
      .addTextDisplayComponents((textDisplay) => textDisplay.setContent('# Guilds'));

    for (const guild of guilds) {
      const icon = guild.iconURL();
      if (icon) {
        container.addSectionComponents((section) => section
          .addTextDisplayComponents((textDisplay) => textDisplay.setContent(guild.name))
          .setThumbnailAccessory((thumbnail) => thumbnail.setURL(icon))
        );
      } else {
        container.addTextDisplayComponents((textDisplay) => textDisplay.setContent(guild.name));
      }
    }

    return container;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
    }

    return container;
  }
}
```

  </Tab>

You can then use it in your command or anywhere where you have an interaction:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
// ---cut-start---
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { AbstractListPaginationSession, type DjsSessionStartInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { Guild, ContainerBuilder } from 'discord.js';

class GuildsPaginationSession extends AbstractListPaginationSession<Guild, void> {
  constructor(options: {
    bot: NyxBot;
    id: string;
    startInteraction: DjsSessionStartInteraction;
    items: Guild[];
  }) {
    super(options);
  }

  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
  protected async updatePage() { return true; }
  protected generateContainer() { return null as unknown as ContainerBuilder; }
}

declare const startInteraction: DjsSessionStartInteraction;
declare const bot: NyxBot;
declare const items: Guild[];
const id = 'mySessionId';
// ---cut-end---
const session = new GuildsPaginationSession({ bot, id, startInteraction, items });
await session.start();
```

# Pagination Session (https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/session/types/pagination-session)

<Callout type="warn">It's recommended to read the [Session](./session) page first, all of its features apply to this.</Callout>

A `PaginationSession` is a special type of session made to be paginated (have pages).

From a manager's perspective, a pagination session is just a regular session. The pagination logic happens inside the session
itself.

## Page switch [#page-switch]

A page switch is triggered when the user sends an interaction to the pagination session, and a page can be extracted from it:

<ol>
  <li>It attempts to extract a referred page, depending on the interaction type:<ul><li>Buttons: Extracts from the customId.</li><li>Select Menu: Extracts from the customId. If no page is present there, and it's a `StringSelectMenu`, and only one value was selected, it extracts from the selected value.</li><li>Modal: Extracts from the customId. If no page is present there, it iterates through the modal's components, searching for a component whose `customId` is the session's `customId`. If there is one, the page is extracted from said component's value.</li></ul></li>
  <li>If there's no referred page, it behaves like a regular session, passing the interaction to the appropiate handler.</li>
  <li>If there's a referred page, it updates its `currentPage` and calls `#updatePage()`.</li>
</ol>

<Callout title ="Overriding page resolving">
You can override this behavior by overriding `extractPageFromInteraction()`, or the more concrete methods:
- `extractPageFromButton()` for buttons
- `extractPageFromSelectMenu()` for select menus
- `extractPageFromModal()` for modals
</Callout>

## Creation [#creation]

<Steps>
<Step>
### Creation [#creation-1]
Extend the `AbstractPaginationSession` class:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractPaginationSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

// ---cut-start---
// @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
// ---cut-end---
class MyPaginationSession extends AbstractPaginationSession {}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractPaginationSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

// ---cut-start---
// @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
// ---cut-end---
class MyPaginationSession extends AbstractPaginationSession {}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { AbstractPaginationSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

// ---cut-start---
// @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
// ---cut-end---
class MyPaginationSession extends AbstractPaginationSession {}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>
</Step>
<Step>
### Implementation [#implementation]

Apart from the base `Session` implementation, also implement the `updatePage()` method:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractPaginationSession, type DjsSessionUpdateInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

// ---cut-start---
class MyPaginationSession extends AbstractPaginationSession<void> {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
// ---cut-end---
  protected async updatePage(interaction: DjsSessionUpdateInteraction): Promise<boolean> {
    if ('update' in interaction) {
      await interaction.update({ content: `Page: ${this.currentPage}` });
    }
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractPaginationSession, type CoreSessionUpdateInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

// ---cut-start---
class MyPaginationSession extends AbstractPaginationSession<void> {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
// ---cut-end---
  protected async updatePage(interaction: CoreSessionUpdateInteraction): Promise<boolean> {
    await interaction.api.interactions.updateMessage(interaction.data.id, interaction.data.token, {
      content: `Page: ${this.currentPage}`,
    });
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { AbstractPaginationSession, type CoreSessionUpdateInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

// ---cut-start---
class MyPaginationSession extends AbstractPaginationSession<void> {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
// ---cut-end---
  protected async updatePage(interaction: CoreSessionUpdateInteraction): Promise<boolean> {
    await interaction.api.interactions.updateMessage(interaction.data.id, interaction.data.token, {
      content: `Page: ${this.currentPage}`,
    });
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

Similarly to `update()`, it must return whether the session's TTL should be renewed or not.

</Step>
<Step>
### Initialization [#initialization]

Instantiate and start your session the same way as a regular one:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
// ---cut-start---
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { AbstractPaginationSession, type DjsSessionStartInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

class MyPaginationSession extends AbstractPaginationSession<void> {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
  protected async updatePage() { return true; }
}

declare const interaction: DjsSessionStartInteraction;
declare const bot: NyxBot;
const sessionId = 'mySessionId';
// ---cut-end---
const session = new MyPaginationSession({ bot, id: sessionId, startInteraction: interaction });
await session.start();
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
// ---cut-start---

  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
  protected async updatePage() { return true; }
}

declare const bot: NyxBot;
const sessionId = 'mySessionId';
// ---cut-end---
```

  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

  </Tab>

</Step>

## Pagination customId [#pagination-customid]

The page to switch to is usually extracted from the customId. This means you'll need to change the way you build it in case you want to make a component that switches to a specific page.

<Tabs items={['Button', 'Select Menu', 'Modal']}>
<Tab>

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { ButtonBuilder } from 'discord.js';
import { AbstractPaginationSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

// @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
class MyPaginationSession extends AbstractPaginationSession<void> {
  public async start() {
// ---cut---
// For a specific page
const buttonId = this.buildPageCustomId(3);
const pageThreeButton = new ButtonBuilder()
  .setCustomId(buttonId)
  .setLabel('Go to page 3');

// For the next page
const nextPageButtonId = this.buildPageCustomId(this.currentPage + 1);
const nextPageButton = new ButtonBuilder()
  .setCustomId(nextPageButtonId)
  .setLabel('Next page');
// ---cut-after---
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { ButtonBuilder } from 'discord.js';
import { AbstractPaginationSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

// @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
class MyPaginationSession extends AbstractPaginationSession<void> {
  public async start() {
// ---cut---
// For a specific page
const buttonId = this.buildPageCustomId(3);
const pageThreeButton = new ButtonBuilder()
  .setCustomId(buttonId)
  .setLabel('Go to page 3');

// For the next page
const nextPageButtonId = this.buildPageCustomId(this.currentPage + 1);
const nextPageButton = new ButtonBuilder()
  .setCustomId(nextPageButtonId)
  .setLabel('Next page');
// ---cut-after---
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

You can add more ways by overriding `extractPageFromButton()`.

</Tab>
<Tab>

You can either:

* Put the pagination custom id in the select menu itself, making it switch to that page regardless of selection.

```ts twoslash
import { SelectMenuBuilder, StringSelectMenuOptionBuilder } from 'discord.js';
import { AbstractPaginationSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

// @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
class MyPaginationSession extends AbstractPaginationSession<void> {
  public async start() {
// ---cut---
const selectId = this.buildPageCustomId(3);
const select = new SelectMenuBuilder()
  .setCustomId(selectId)
  .setPlaceholder('Switch to page 3')
// ---cut-after---
  }
}
```

* Put the pagination custom id in the select menu's options, making it switch to that page only when the option is selected.
  Note that you still need to put the session's custom id in the select menu itself.

```ts twoslash
import { StringSelectMenuBuilder, StringSelectMenuOptionBuilder } from 'discord.js';
import { AbstractPaginationSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

// @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
class MyPaginationSession extends AbstractPaginationSession<void> {
  public async start() {
// ---cut---
const selectId = this.buildCustomId();
const select = new StringSelectMenuBuilder()
  .setPlaceholder('Go to page...')
  .setCustomId(selectId)
  .addOptions([
    new StringSelectMenuOptionBuilder()
      .setLabel('1')
      .setValue(this.buildPageCustomId(1)),
    new StringSelectMenuOptionBuilder()
      .setLabel('2')
      .setValue(this.buildPageCustomId(2)),
  ]);
// ---cut-after---
  }
}
```

You can add more ways by overriding `extractPageFromSelectMenu()`.

</Tab>
<Tab>

You can either:

* Put the pagination custom id in the modal itself, making it switch to that page regardless of values.

```ts twoslash
import { ModalBuilder, TextInputBuilder } from 'discord.js';
import { AbstractPaginationSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

// @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
class MyPaginationSession extends AbstractPaginationSession<void> {
  public async start() {
// ---cut---
const modalId = this.buildPageCustomId(3);
const modal = new ModalBuilder()
  // highlight-next-line
  .setCustomId(modalId)
  .setTitle('A modal that switches to page 3');
// ---cut-after---
  }
}
```

* Put the session's custom id in the modal's components, making it switch to that component's value (if it's a number).
  Note that you still need to put the session's custom id in the modal.

  <Callout type="warn">If the component's value is not a number, it will be handled as a regular update (`handleModal()`).</Callout>

```ts twoslash
import { ModalBuilder, TextInputBuilder, ActionRowBuilder } from 'discord.js';
import { AbstractPaginationSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

// @ts-expect-error Incomplete example
class MyPaginationSession extends AbstractPaginationSession<void> {
  public async start() {
// ---cut---
const customId = this.buildCustomId();
const modal = new ModalBuilder()
  .setCustomId(customId)
  .setTitle('Type a page number')
  .addComponents(new ActionRowBuilder<TextInputBuilder>().addComponents(
    new TextInputBuilder().setCustomId(customId)
      .setLabel('Page')
  ));
// ---cut-after---
  }
}
```

</Tab>
</Tabs>

<Callout title="Page switch row">

The `AbstractPaginationSession` has a utility method for building an action row containing two buttons that switch to the previous and next page:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
// ---cut-start---
import { ActionRowBuilder, ButtonBuilder } from 'discord.js';
import { AbstractPaginationSession, type DjsSessionUpdateInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

class MyPaginationSession extends AbstractPaginationSession<void> {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
  protected async updatePage(_interaction: DjsSessionUpdateInteraction) { return true; }

  public async example() {
// ---cut-end---
const row = this.buildBasicPageRow();
await this.startInteraction.reply({ components: [row] });
// ---cut-start---
  }
}
// ---cut-end---
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
// ---cut-start---
import { ActionRowBuilder, ButtonBuilder } from 'discord.js';
import { AbstractPaginationSession, type CoreSessionUpdateInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

class MyPaginationSession extends AbstractPaginationSession<void> {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
  protected async updatePage(_interaction: CoreSessionUpdateInteraction) { return true; }

  public async example() {
// ---cut-end---
const row = this.buildBasicPageRow();
await this.startInteraction.api.interactions.reply(
  this.startInteraction.data.id,
  this.startInteraction.data.token,
  { components: [row] },
);
// ---cut-start---
  }
}
// ---cut-end---
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash

// ---cut-start---
  }
}
// ---cut-end---
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

This row uses emoji arrows to avoid issues with localized text.

</Callout>


# Session (https://nyx-discord.github.io/nyx/guide/session/types/session)

<Callout type="warn">It's recommended to read the [Overview](../) page first.</Callout>

A `Session` is the simplest, most generic object for the sessions API. It replies to interactions it receives and ends after a given TTL.

Further session types are based on this one, and are specifically built for other common use cases.

## Usage [#usage]

<Steps>
<Step>

### Creation [#creation]

Extend the `AbstractSession` class:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

// ---cut-start---
class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
}
// ---cut-end---
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

// ---cut-start---
class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
}
// ---cut-end---
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

// ---cut-start---
class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
}
// ---cut-end---
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

There's an optional type argument which is the [return type](#session-result) of your session, which will be explained later.

</Step>
<Step>

### Implementation [#implementation]

Implement the `onStart` and `onEnd` methods:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {
    // Reply to the startInteraction
  }

  public async onEnd() {
    // Do something when the session ends
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {
    // Reply to the startInteraction
  }

  public async onEnd() {
    // Do something when the session ends
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {
    // Reply to the startInteraction
  }

  public async onEnd() {
    // Do something when the session ends
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

Your `onStart` method should perform the initial reply, and `onEnd` any necessary cleanup logic.

<Callout type="warn">
If the `onStart` method errors, the session will not be registered and the `onEnd` method will not be called.
</Callout>

Optionally implement `handleButton`, `handleSelectMenu`, and `handleModal` methods to listen to interactions:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { ButtonInteraction, AnySelectMenuInteraction, ModalSubmitInteraction } from 'discord.js';

class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  // ---cut-start---
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
  // ---cut-end---
  protected async handleButton(interaction: ButtonInteraction) {
    // Reply to buttons
    return true;
  }

  protected async handleSelectMenu(interaction: AnySelectMenuInteraction) {
    // Reply to select menus
    return true;
  }

  protected async handleModal(interaction: ModalSubmitInteraction) {
    // Reply to modals
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type {
  ToEventProps,
  APIMessageComponentButtonInteraction,
  APIMessageComponentSelectMenuInteraction,
  APIModalSubmitInteraction,
} from '@discordjs/core';

class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  // ---cut-start---
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
  // ---cut-end---
  protected async handleButton(interaction: ToEventProps<APIMessageComponentButtonInteraction>) {
    // Reply to buttons
    return true;
  }

  protected async handleSelectMenu(interaction: ToEventProps<APIMessageComponentSelectMenuInteraction>) {
    // Reply to select menus
    return true;
  }

  protected async handleModal(interaction: ToEventProps<APIModalSubmitInteraction>) {
    // Reply to modals
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash

```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

</Step>
<Step>

### Initialization [#initialization]

Somewhere in your code where you want to start a session, create an id for it, instantiate and start the session:

<Callout>
  In production your ID should be randomly generated using something like [nanoid](https://www.npmjs.com/package/nanoid), and it should be short enough to not collide with extra customId data.

  You can use [nanoid's collission calculator](https://zelark.github.io/nano-id-cc/) to find out how short your ID needs to be.
  Consider a collision only happens if two **currently active** sessions have the same ID.
</Callout>

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
// ---cut-start---
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { AbstractSession, type DjsSessionStartInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
}

declare const interaction: DjsSessionStartInteraction;
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut-end---
const sessionId = 'mySessionId';
const session = new MySession({ bot, id: sessionId, startInteraction: interaction });
await session.start();
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
// ---cut-start---
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import { AbstractSession, type CoreSessionStartInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
}

declare const interaction: CoreSessionStartInteraction;
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut-end---
const sessionId = 'mySessionId';
const session = new MySession({ bot, id: sessionId, startInteraction: interaction });
await session.start();
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash

```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

</Step>
</Steps>

## Component customIds [#component-customids]

Given sessions aren't limited to a single `Message`, and the framework needs to know to which session a given component belongs to, you'll need to go through the `buildCustomId` method in order to get your customIds.
This will append the necessary information to the customId to allow the framework to know how to route the interaction.

You can also append extra data to it by passing it to the method, and it will be saved in the `TypedFields.CustomIdExtra` field.

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import { TypedFields, type Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { ButtonBuilder, ActionRowBuilder, type ButtonInteraction } from 'discord.js';

// ---cut-start---
class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
// ---cut-end---
  public async start() {
    const customId = this.buildCustomId('my-data'); // [!code highlight]

    const button = new ButtonBuilder().setCustomId(customId);
    const row = new ActionRowBuilder<ButtonBuilder>().addComponents(button);
    await this.startInteraction.reply({ components: [row] });
  }

  protected async handleButton(interaction: ButtonInteraction, meta: Metadata) {
    // We can force the get here (`true`) since we know we passed 'my-data'
    const extra = TypedFields.CustomIdExtra.get(meta, true); // [!code highlight]
    await interaction.reply(extra); // Replies 'my-data';
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import { TypedFields, type Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import { ButtonBuilder, ActionRowBuilder } from 'discord.js';
import type { ToEventProps, APIMessageComponentButtonInteraction } from '@discordjs/core';

// ---cut-start---
class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
// ---cut-end---
  public async start() {
    const customId = this.buildCustomId('my-data'); // [!code highlight]

    const button = new ButtonBuilder().setCustomId(customId);
    const row = new ActionRowBuilder<ButtonBuilder>().addComponents(button);
    await this.startInteraction.api.interactions.reply(
      this.startInteraction.data.id,
      this.startInteraction.data.token,
      { components: [row.toJSON()] }
    );
  }

  protected async handleButton(interaction: ToEventProps<APIMessageComponentButtonInteraction>, meta: Metadata) {
    // We can force the get here (`true`) since we know we passed 'my-data'
    const extra = TypedFields.CustomIdExtra.get(meta, true); // [!code highlight]
    await interaction.api.interactions.reply(
      interaction.data.id,
      interaction.data.token,
      { content: extra }
    ); // Replies 'my-data';
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash

  public async onEnd() {}
// ---cut-end---

    const button = new ButtonBuilder().setCustomId(customId);
    const row = new ActionRowBuilder<ButtonBuilder>().addComponents(button);
    await this.startInteraction.api.interactions.reply(
      this.startInteraction.data.id,
      this.startInteraction.data.token,
      { components: [row.toJSON()] }
    );
  }

  protected async handleButton(interaction: ToEventProps<APIMessageComponentButtonInteraction>, meta: Metadata) {
    // We can force the get here (`true`) since we know we passed 'my-data'
    const extra = TypedFields.CustomIdExtra.get(meta, true); // [!code highlight]
    await interaction.api.interactions.reply(
      interaction.data.id,
      interaction.data.token,
      { content: extra }
    ); // Replies 'my-data';
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

### Complex data [#complex-data]

If you need to store a complex object as extra data you can consider using the [`@sapphire/string-store`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sapphire/string-store) package, which is what
the framework and plugin already uses for serialization to short strings:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import { TypedFields, type Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { Schema, SchemaStore } from '@sapphire/string-store';
import { ButtonBuilder, ActionRowBuilder, type ButtonInteraction } from 'discord.js';

// ---cut-start---
class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
// ---cut-end---
  protected static readonly Store = new SchemaStore()
    // Add an schema with a 'name' field stored as a string and an 'age' field stored as a int32:
    .add(new Schema(0).string('name').int32('age'));

  public async start() {
    const extra = MySession.Store.serialize(0, { age: 25, name: 'amgelo563' }); // [!code highlight]
    const customId = this.buildCustomId(extra);

    const button = new ButtonBuilder().setCustomId(customId);
    const row = new ActionRowBuilder<ButtonBuilder>().addComponents(button);
    await this.startInteraction.reply({ components: [row] });
  }

  protected async handleButton(interaction: ButtonInteraction, meta: Metadata) {
    // We can force the get here (`true`) since we know we passed an extra
    const extra = TypedFields.CustomIdExtra.get(meta, true);
    const deserialized = MySession.Store.deserialize(extra).data; // { age: 25, name: 'amgelo563' } // [!code highlight]
    await interaction.reply(`Name: ${deserialized.name}, Age: ${deserialized.age}`);
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import { TypedFields, type Metadata } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import { Schema, SchemaStore } from '@sapphire/string-store';
import { ButtonBuilder, ActionRowBuilder } from 'discord.js';
import type { ToEventProps, APIMessageComponentButtonInteraction } from '@discordjs/core';

// ---cut-start---

  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
// ---cut-end---
  protected static readonly Store = new SchemaStore()
    // Add an schema with a 'name' field stored as a string and an 'age' field stored as a int32:
    .add(new Schema(0).string('name').int32('age'));

    const customId = this.buildCustomId(extra);

    const button = new ButtonBuilder().setCustomId(customId);
    const row = new ActionRowBuilder<ButtonBuilder>().addComponents(button);
    await this.startInteraction.api.interactions.reply(
      this.startInteraction.data.id,
      this.startInteraction.data.token,
      { components: [row.toJSON()] }
    );
  }

  protected async handleButton(interaction: ToEventProps<APIMessageComponentButtonInteraction>, meta: Metadata) {
    // We can force the get here (`true`) since we know we passed an extra

    await interaction.api.interactions.reply(
      interaction.data.id,
      interaction.data.token,
      { content: `Name: ${deserialized.name}, Age: ${deserialized.age}` }
    );
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>

## Session lifecycle [#session-lifecycle]

After it's started, a session will have a given TTL before ending. The default is 3 minutes, and it can be overriden per session (in milliseconds):

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

// ---cut-start---
class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
}
// ---cut-end---
class MySessionTtl extends AbstractSession {
  // ---cut-start---
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
  // ---cut-end---
  protected readonly ttl = 10_000; // 10 seconds
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

// ---cut-start---
class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
}
// ---cut-end---
class MySessionTtl extends AbstractSession {
  // ---cut-start---
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
  // ---cut-end---
  protected readonly ttl = 10_000; // 10 seconds
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

// ---cut-start---
class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
}
// ---cut-end---
class MySessionTtl extends AbstractSession {
  // ---cut-start---
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
  // ---cut-end---
  protected readonly ttl = 10_000; // 10 seconds
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

When the session receives an interaction, it can decide whether or not to renew its TTL by returning `true` on the appropiate handler (or `false` to not renew it):

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import type { ButtonInteraction } from 'discord.js';

class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  // ---cut-start---
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
  // ---cut-end---
  protected async handleButton(interaction: ButtonInteraction) {
    if (interaction.user.id !== this.startInteraction.user.id) {
      await interaction.reply('You cannot use this button!');
      return false;
    }
    await interaction.reply('Hello!');
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import type { ToEventProps, APIMessageComponentButtonInteraction } from '@discordjs/core';

class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  // ---cut-start---
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
  // ---cut-end---
  protected async handleButton(interaction: ToEventProps<APIMessageComponentButtonInteraction>) {
    const userId = interaction.data.member?.user.id ?? interaction.data.user?.id;
    const startUserId = this.startInteraction.data.member?.user.id ?? this.startInteraction.data.user?.id;
    if (userId !== startUserId) {
      await interaction.api.interactions.reply(
        interaction.data.id,
        interaction.data.token,
        { content: 'You cannot use this button!' }
      );
      return false;
    }
    await interaction.api.interactions.reply(
      interaction.data.id,
      interaction.data.token,
      { content: 'Hello!' }
    );
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash

    const startUserId = this.startInteraction.data.member?.user.id ?? this.startInteraction.data.user?.id;
    if (userId !== startUserId) {
      await interaction.api.interactions.reply(
        interaction.data.id,
        interaction.data.token,
        { content: 'You cannot use this button!' }
      );
      return false;
    }
    await interaction.api.interactions.reply(
      interaction.data.id,
      interaction.data.token,
      { content: 'Hello!' }
    );
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

This is useful to "filter out" interactions that you don't want to renew the TTL of, like from other users or with invalid input.

### End promise [#end-promise]

Sessions are asynchronous by nature, and you may want to wait for a session to finish before continuing. The `getEndPromise()` method returns a promise that resolves when the session ends, either by timeout or manual end.

This promise resolves to an <DocsLink pkg="plugin-sessions" name="SessionEndData" decorated={false} label="SessionEndData" /> object containing the session's final state and result:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
// ---cut-start---
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { AbstractSession, type DjsSessionStartInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
}

declare const interaction: DjsSessionStartInteraction;
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut-end---
const session = new MySession({ bot, id: 'mySessionId', startInteraction: interaction });
await session.start();

// Wait for the session to end
const endData = await session.getEndPromise();
console.log('Session ended');
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
// ---cut-start---
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import { AbstractSession, type CoreSessionStartInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
}

declare const interaction: CoreSessionStartInteraction;
declare const bot: NyxBot;
// ---cut-end---
const session = new MySession({ bot, id: 'mySessionId', startInteraction: interaction });
await session.start();

// Wait for the session to end
const endData = await session.getEndPromise();
console.log('Session ended');
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash
// ---cut-start---
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/http';
import { AbstractSession, type CoreSessionStartInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}

await session.start();

// Wait for the session to end
const endData = await session.getEndPromise();
console.log('Session ended');
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

This is particularly useful when you want to perform additional actions after a session completes, such as logging, notifications, or cleanup operations.

### Result [#result]

Sessions can specify a `result` that will be passed to awaiters of the session's promise, and the session end event:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';
import { ButtonBuilder, ActionRowBuilder, type ButtonInteraction } from 'discord.js';

class MySession extends AbstractSession<number> {
//                                      ^^^^^^
  protected override result = 0; // [!code highlight]

  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}

  public async start() {
    const customId = this.buildCustomId();
    const button = new ButtonBuilder()
      .setLabel('Click to increment!')
      .setCustomId(customId);
    const row = new ActionRowBuilder<ButtonBuilder>().addComponents(button);

    await this.startInteraction.reply({
      content: this.result.toString(),
      components: [row],
    });
  }

  protected async handleButton(interaction: ButtonInteraction) {
    this.result += 1; // [!code highlight]
    await interaction.update({ content: this.result.toString() });
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
import { AbstractSession } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';
import { ButtonBuilder, ActionRowBuilder } from 'discord.js';
import type { ToEventProps, APIMessageComponentButtonInteraction } from '@discordjs/core';

class MySession extends AbstractSession<number> {
//                                      ^^^^^^
  protected override result = 0; // [!code highlight]

  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}

  public async start() {
    const customId = this.buildCustomId();
    const button = new ButtonBuilder()
      .setLabel('Click to increment!')
      .setCustomId(customId);
    const row = new ActionRowBuilder<ButtonBuilder>().addComponents(button);

    await this.startInteraction.api.interactions.reply(
      this.startInteraction.data.id,
      this.startInteraction.data.token,
      { content: this.result.toString(), components: [row.toJSON()] }
    );
  }

  protected async handleButton(interaction: ToEventProps<APIMessageComponentButtonInteraction>) {
    this.result += 1; // [!code highlight]
    await interaction.api.interactions.updateMessage(
      interaction.data.id,
      interaction.data.token,
      { content: this.result.toString() }
    );
    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

```ts twoslash

    return true;
  }
}
```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

The default value of the `result` is `null`, which is what consumers will receive if you don't set it.

<Callout>
  The `onEnd()` method will be called **before** the framework gets the result from the session, so you can use it to make some final changes to it,
  before it's communicated to the consumer.
</Callout>

Then you can await the session's promise to get the result:

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
// ---cut-start---
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { AbstractSession, type DjsSessionStartInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

class MySession extends AbstractSession<number> {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
}

declare const interaction: DjsSessionStartInteraction;
declare const bot: NyxBot;
const id = 'mySessionId';
// ---cut-end---
const session = new MySession({ bot, id, startInteraction: interaction });
await session.start();
const endData = await session.getEndPromise();
//    ^?
const result = endData.result;
//    ^?
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>

  </Tab>

A useful use case is to make sessions where a user is "building" something, and you want to get the final result the user inputted.

## Metadata [#metadata]

When extending with plugins, you may want to specify extra data for them to read. You can do so with the `Metadata` object, saved on the session.

<Callout>
While sessions internally save a `Metadata`, the return type of `#getMeta()` is a `ReadonlyMetadata`,
meaning that external objects can read the object, but not modify it.
</Callout>

<Tabs items={['discord.js', '@discordjs/core', 'HTTP']}>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
// ---cut-start---
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs';
import { AbstractSession, type DjsSessionStartInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs';

class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
  protected override readonly meta = {
    someKey: 'someValue',
  };
}

declare const interaction: DjsSessionStartInteraction;
declare const bot: NyxBot;
const id = 'mySessionId';
// ---cut-end---
const session = new MySession({ bot, id, startInteraction: interaction });
const meta = session.getMeta();
const value = meta['someKey']; // 'someValue'
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
```ts twoslash
// ---cut-start---
import type { NyxBot } from '@nyx-discord/djs-core';
import { AbstractSession, type CoreSessionStartInteraction } from '@nyx-discord/plugin-sessions/djs-core';

class MySession extends AbstractSession {
  public async onStart() {}
  public async onEnd() {}
  protected override readonly meta = {
    someKey: 'someValue',
  };
}

declare const interaction: CoreSessionStartInteraction;
declare const bot: NyxBot;
const id = 'mySessionId';
// ---cut-end---
const session = new MySession({ bot, id, startInteraction: interaction });
const meta = session.getMeta();
const value = meta['someKey']; // 'someValue'
```
  </Tab>
  <Tab>
  Same as `@discordjs/core`, importing from `@nyx-discord/http`:

